jobs.title: Principal Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.

At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee-first process. Our vision is the same: a place where employees know they can thrive.

TTEC Digital is seeking a Principal Technical Project Manager for our Data and Analytics team. This is a 100% remote role with limited travel. You will lead delivery of client engagements on Google Cloud, including data platform migrations, BigQuery and Looker builds, and ML/AI solutions on Vertex AI.

### **What you'll be doing:**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of data and analytics projects with teams of 3 to 20+ (TTEC staff, contractors, client resources, and vendors)
* Run hybrid delivery: Agile sprints for build work and milestone plans for fixed-scope SOWs and migrations
* Manage project delivery risks such as source access, data quality, reconciliation sign-off, and user adoption
* Own project delivery report status, risks, and decisions to senior stakeholders and steering committees
* Manage project financials: budget, forecast, utilization, margin, change orders, and invoice review

### **Skills and experience you will bring**

* 5+ years of project management in consulting or professional services
* 3+ years managing data and analytics projects (data platforms, cloud migrations, BI, or ML/AI)
* Working knowledge of the data lifecycle and at least one cloud data platform; Google Cloud strongly preferred
* Experience with Agile/Scrum and fixed-scope delivery, using tools such as MS Project, Jira, etc.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with strong attention to detail

Nice to have

* Experience with BI or data platform migrations (e.g., Azure to BigQuery, Power BI to Looker)
* Experience in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare/HIPAA)
* PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM certification

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Location:** This role is fully remote. If you live in or near Richmond, VA, a hybrid setup is also an option.  
**Salary range:** $130,000 +, final pay depends on experience level and location.

The Program Manager owns the successful strategy execution, coordination, and delivery of a  
portfolio of related projects for enterprise-level clients and is focused on achieving key business outcomes.

The Program Manager develops the plan and direction, aligns cross-functional workstreams, and ensures  
that the combined output delivers measurable customer and business value.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Planning & Road Mapping

* Define and maintain the overall program structure, vision, and multi-quarter roadmap.
* Translate business objectives into program goals, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritize and sequence workstreams based on strategic impact, dependencies, and resource

constraints.

Cross-Workstream Coordination

* Coordinate multiple workstreams (e.g., Strategic Consulting, AI scenario development, LMS

implementation, content development, integrations, change management).  

* Ensure alignment between business objectives, timelines, and delivery execution across all projects.
* Manage interdependencies across projects and teams to prevent siloed decision-making and

delivery conflicts.

Governance & Decision-Making

* Establish and enforce consistent governance across all projects (standards, processes, reporting,

escalation paths).  

* Drive program-level decision-making and escalate issues that impact scope, timeline, budget, or

strategic alignment.  

* Facilitate cross-functional forums (steering committees, working groups) to resolve conflicts and

align priorities.

Risk, Dependency & Issue Management

* Identify, assess, and mitigate cross-project risks and issues that could derail program outcomes.
* Maintain a living risk register and dependency map, with clear ownership and mitigation plans.
* Proactively surface and resolve blockers that span multiple teams or systems.

Stakeholder & Executive Communication

* Provide program-level reporting to executives and stakeholders (status, risks, decisions needed,

value tracking).  

* Tailor communication to audience: tactical updates for delivery teams, strategic narratives for

leadership.  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across functions (Product,

Engineering, L&D, HR, Customer Success, etc.).  
Value Realization & Continuous Improvement  

* Align program outcomes with customer success and business value realization (adoption, efficiency

gains, revenue impact, etc.).  

* Define and track value realization metrics post-delivery to ensure benefits are achieved.
* Continuously improve program processes, templates, and tools based on lessons learned and

feedback.

Key Skills:

* Thrives in ambiguity.
* Able to influence without authority, and has a track record of turning complex, multi-team

initiatives into coherent, executable plans.  

* Thinks strategically and systemically and can connect day-to-day work to long-term business

goals, see interdependencies and optimize the whole, not just individual projects.  

* Operates as a servant leader, removes blockers, empowers teams, and fosters psychological

safety.  

* Is decisive in uncertainty and comfortable making recommendations with incomplete

information.  

* Uses metrics to drive date-informed decisions, not just status reporting.

Required Qualifications:  
  

* 7+ years of experience in program/project management, with at least 3+ years managing multi-

project programs in a SaaS, tech, or professional services environment.  

* Proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs (e.g., platform implementations,

product launches, enterprise transformations).  

* Strong understanding of program management frameworks (e.g., PMI, Agile/SAFe, hybrid models)

and tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet).  

* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence

at all levels.  

* Demonstrated ability to think strategically while staying grounded in execution details.

Preferred  

* Experience in Learning & Development, HR Tech, or AI technology(e.g., LMS implementations,

content platforms).  

* Pharma sales enablement project management and/or program management experience
* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification; Agile/SAFe credentials a plus.
* Background in change management, organizational design, or process improvement.
* Experience working in small to mid-sized companies (50–200 employees) where roles are

demanding, fluid, and impact is high

jobs.title: Customer Organization Program Manager
jobs.description:
*\*An internal or pre-identified candidate is currently under consideration, but all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.*

  

**Customer Organization Program Manager**

  

Join Epicor as a Program manager! The Customer Organization Program Manager owns the development of Epicor's FY27 sales plays from strategy to enablement. You will turn identified sales plays into playbooks, content and training that help sellers lead with business outcomes, not features.

  

You'll sit at the center of Sales, Product Marketing and Demand Generation. You'll build the programs and hand-offs that connect them, so every launch, campaign and training lands as one cohesive story for sellers and customers. This is a new role on a growing Revenue Enablement team, with the ability to influence how Epicor goes to market.

  

**What you will be doing**

  

**Own the sales plays**

  

* Build and maintain a playbook for each FY27 sales play: target personas (CFO, COO, CIO, CXO), verticals, discovery questions, value messages, proof points, objection handling and competitive positioning.

* Identify the content each play needs at each sales stage, audit what exists, and fill the gaps.

* Coordinate content development between Sales, Product Marketing and SMEs, managing timelines, owners and approvals.

* Coordinate rollout and training for each play alongside enablement lead, from launch sessions to manager coaching guides and reinforcement.

Run the rolling 2-quarter enablement roadmap with Product Marketing, so product launches are packaged into play-based training.  

  

**Strengthen the Marketing–Sales partnership**

  

* Design programs and clear hand-offs between Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales, from MQL to SAL through to Discovery.

* Act as stakeholder from Sales on Insight conference development and delivery.

* Align campaign messaging with sales plays so sellers can follow up on what marketing starts.

Set up feedback loops with sellers and sales leaders and bring field insight back to Marketing and Product.  

  

**Activate plays in market**

  

* Work with Marketing and regional sales leaders on market activation: campaigns, events, account-based programs and partner motions tied to each play.

* Work with enablement lead to select the right format for each audience and moment, such as live sessions, microlearning, play kits, battlecards, talk tracks, demo stories and digital sales rooms.

Write clear, compelling seller-facing communications for launches, play updates and program news.  

  

**Measure and improve**

  

* Define and report success measures for each play: adoption, content usage, pipeline created and win rate in the target segment.

Use the data to refine plays, retire content that isn't working, and prioritize what comes next.  

  

**Other enablement projects**

  

* Support broader Customer Organization strategic initiatives, including leader programs, sales kickoffs, onboarding and tools rollouts, and others as assigned.

Support with Chief of Staff duties as assigned.  

  

**What you will likely bring**

  

* 10+ years of experience across sales enablement, product or solution marketing, sales programs, or marketing communications in B2B technology. Experience in an ERP organization or similar complex SaaS is required.

* A track record of building sales plays, playbooks or go-to-market programs that sellers actually use.

* Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex product capabilities into clear business outcome and value messages.

* Program management discipline: you can run multiple workstreams, timelines and stakeholders at once and keep them on track.

* Experience influencing without authority across Sales, Marketing and Product, including with senior leaders.

* Comfort designing and delivering training, both live and virtual, to sales audiences.

* An analytical mindset, with experience using CRM and enablement data to measure impact.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.  

  

**What could set you apart**

  

* Background in communications or PR, especially message development, internal communications or change communications.

* Experience with ERP, supply chain or industry software sold to manufacturing, distribution, retail, automotive or building supply businesses.

* Familiarity with value selling, MEDDICC, Challenger or similar sales methodologies.

* Hands-on experience with tools such as Salesforce, Gong, Highspot, Seismic or an LMS.

* Experience with account-based marketing, demand generation programs or partner enablement.

* Experience using AI tools to speed up content creation, research or enablement delivery.

Prior experience leading or mentoring others, or a desire to build a team.  

  

**What success looks like in your first year**

  

* **First 60 days:** Learn the four plays, sellers and stakeholders. Audit existing content against each play, and build first sales play.

* **By 6 months:** Launch complete playbooks for at least three plays, with training delivered to Account Executives/TMs and CAMs, and an agreed Marketing-to-Sales hand-off process.

* **By 12 months:** All four plays are live and refreshed quarterly. Fewer standalone feature trainings reach sellers, and play adoption and pipeline impact are reported to leadership each quarter.

  

#LI-KT1 #LI-REMOTE

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000 talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.

**We’re** **Proactive, Proud, Partners** **.**

jobs.description:
Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.

Founded in 2009, we continue to be recognized for our intentional culture and tremendous growth (Best Place to Work in Fintech; Best & Brightest to Work For Nationally; and Comparably’s Best Company Culture, Best Career Growth, Best Engineering Team, and Best Places to Work in Dallas, among others). We’re building a culture where each Alkamist can perform to their highest potential, and we’re always on the lookout for the best and brightest minds. If you’re ready to experience the power of alchemy - transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary - come join one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the U.S.

As a remote-first company, most of our positions can be remote in the US, except for key roles, which will be indicated in the Job Title.

Follow us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn!

The Project Manager, Implementation is responsible for coordinating client implementation projects by managing schedules, communication, risks, and cross-functional activities to support successful delivery of Alkami Digital Banking solutions. This role applies project management fundamentals and customer relationship skills to ensure implementation activities are completed within scope, timeline, and quality expectations while maintaining a customer-focused delivery experience. The position works collaboratively with internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders to coordinate implementation execution, monitor progress, and support issue resolution across assigned project portfolios. The Project Manager, Implementation operates with moderate autonomy, manages multiple concurrent projects, and contributes to delivery consistency and operational effectiveness across implementation engagements.

**Essential Duties &** **Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned implementation projects by developing and maintaining project schedules, tracking milestones, and coordinating delivery activities across customer and internal stakeholder groups
* Serve as the primary customer contact for assigned implementation engagements by managing communication, setting expectations, and supporting positive customer experiences throughout the project lifecycle
* Coordinate cross-functional implementation activities by partnering with Product Development, Customer Success, Technical Consulting, Engineering, and Customer Support teams to align project execution and delivery timelines
* Track project progress by monitoring milestones, deliverables, risks, and dependencies and escalating concerns when project objectives may be impacted
* Manage Jira tickets, implementation tasks, and customer-reported issues by coordinating resolution efforts and maintaining visibility into project status and outstanding action items
* Facilitate project meetings by preparing agendas, documenting action items, and ensuring follow-up activities are completed according to project timelines
* Develop and maintain project documentation by creating status reports, meeting notes, implementation records, and customer communications throughout the implementation lifecycle
* Support risk management activities by identifying project risks, documenting mitigation plans, and collaborating with stakeholders to address operational or delivery concerns
* Collaborate with customers and vendors by gathering configuration requirements, validating implementation details, and monitoring progress on identified gap items
* Monitor implementation-related development activities by tracking release schedules, sprint updates, and implementation dependencies and communicating relevant updates to stakeholders
* Ensure implementation activities align with customer goals and business objectives by maintaining a customer-centric approach to project execution and issue management
* Manage multiple concurrent implementation projects across various product lines by balancing customer priorities, timelines, and operational responsibilities
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying project management process enhancements and supporting operational efficiency efforts within the PSO
* Maintain strong internal and external working relationships by collaborating effectively with stakeholders to support implementation success and customer satisfaction
* Support team operations by serving as backup coverage for other project managers and assisting with additional project-related responsibilities as needed

**Recommended Experience & Education**

***Minimum Years of Experience***

1–3 years of experience coordinating implementation projects, customer onboarding initiatives, project delivery activities, or client-facing operational programs within SaaS, fintech, banking technology, or related environments.

***Education Level***

  

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, Information Systems, Communications, or a related field.

**Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications**

**Required**

* Experience managing multiple projects, schedules, and customer-facing implementation activities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate project updates, risks, and timelines effectively
* Ability to manage project risks, prioritize tasks, and coordinate cross-functional dependencies
* Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet, Confluence, Slack, or similar platforms
* Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams
* Strong problem-solving

jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Hybrid - partial time on campus/partial time WFH (working/living out of state).  
  

Program Manager
  
  
Lead all phases of complex information technology projects designed as solutions with university-wide impact, and that require high levels of functional integration and involving multiple disciplines to be managed. Perform the full range of the project management lifecycle**:** discovery initiating, planning, budgeting, executing, governance, monitoring and controlling, and closing. Develop detailed plans, schedule, project estimate, and resource plan. Ensure adherence to quality standards. Manage the integration of vendor tasks and track and review vendor deliverables. Provide technical and analytical guidance to project team. Recommend and take action to direct the analysis and solution of problems; revise, as appropriate, to meet changing needs and requirements. Evaluate and assess metrics and project effectiveness. Ensure accurate and timely reporting; prepare specialized and ad hoc reports. Absorb and leverage project related technology to ensure effective project management and collaboration. Leverage steering and executive committees for decision-making, change management, and communications. Advise unit/school regarding post project operations. Provide training to clients/staff.
  
  
IFPS Program Manager

Role **Summary**

  

University is looking for a Program Manager who can translate the agreed vision for a university-wide financial planning platform into a realistic, sequenced project plan and drive disciplined execution.
  
This person needs to operate at the center of a highly decentralized environment, coordinating across finance, IT, schools, and an implementation partner. Working under the direction of the IFPS Business Lead, the Program Manager will manage project operations, governance logistics, risks, commitments, and execution across workstreams, while coordinating stakeholder engagement and change activities.

Must-Have Experience
  
  
Proven success managing complex enterprise technology implementations through multiple project phases.

Exceptional project execution skills**:** integrated scheduling, dependencies, risk and issue management, action tracking, meeting operations, documentation, and reliable follow-through.
  
Excellent Zoom and SharePoint skills, including complex meeting scheduling and administration, screen sharing, document libraries, permissions, version control, and secure information sharing. Advanced proficiency with Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.
  
Experience with Smartsheet; ability to maintain a detailed working schedule and produce clear, digestible leadership-facing timelines.
  
Demonstrated discretion and sound judgment in handling confidential financial, personnel, procurement, contractual, and governance information. Appropriate access decisions and information sharing are essential.
  
Experience operating across complex stakeholder groups, ideally in higher education or a similarly decentralized or federated environment.
  
Excellent written and verbal communication, including accurate meeting notes, polished stakeholder materials, concise status reports, and clear decision documentation.
  
Strong judgment about when to act independently, when to coordinate with the Business Lead or workstream lead, and when to escalate.

Nice-to-Haves
  
Direct Anaplan or financial planning platform implementation experience.
  
Higher education and/or federated organizational experience.
  
Formal program or change management training.

What Makes This Role Distinct / Why It’s Interesting
  
One of the first recent University-wide solutions intended for all Schools/Units, rather than a small pilot.
  
The end state cannot be fully standardized**:** it must balance shared University-level data and processes with legitimate local variation, while remaining reliable and sustainable.
  
High visibility with senior leadership. The Program Manager will be central to maintaining a realistic plan, preparing decision-ready materials, and keeping leadership accurately informed.

What Kind of Person Thrives Here
  
  
Enterprise-minded but pragmatic; understands that perfect standardization is not possible.
  
Diplomatic with backbone**:** builds trust, listens well, frames trade-offs, and follows through.
  
Comfortable in a consensus-oriented culture where relationships and patience matter alongside subject matter expertise.
  
Exceptionally reliable, organized, detail-oriented, and self-sufficient; closes loops without repeated reminders.
  
Proactive but appropriately consultative; learns the context before changing processes and coordinates sensitive stakeholder outreach.
  
Calm under pressure, receptive to feedback, and able to adjust quickly as priorities shift.
  
Can bridge finance and IT; they don’t have to be a technologist, but must be credible with these teams.

Key Deliverables (Designed, Socialized, Accepted, and Implemented in Conjunction with Internal and External Partners)

A. Program Strategy, Scope, and Roadmap

Responsibilities
  
Translate program direction established by the Business Lead and governance into a detailed phase plan for design and implementation.
  
Coordinate scope definition and change control with the Business Lead, Solution Architect, and implementation partner; document agreed common and School/Unit-**specific requirements**.
  
Align the roadmap with major finance cycles and stakeholder capacity constraints.
  
Maintain an integrated schedule and refine sequencing as design sessions, data realities, and stakeholder feedback evolve.

Key Deliverables
  
Monthly project health and executive summaries.
  
Detailed, Smartsheet-ready multi-phase schedule with dates, owners, dependencies, and milestones, paired with a concise leadership-facing roadmap.
  
Documented scope decisions, changes, and prioritized backlog maintained with the appropriate business and technical owners.

B. Governance & Decision-Making

jobs.title: Senior IT Program Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
· Seeking a Senior IT Program Manager to lead a complex, multi-year, multi-million dollar transformation program.

· The Senior IT Program Manager will own program-level planning, governance, financial management, dependency management, and benefits realization across these initiatives, from current state through production launch and transition to operations.

· The Senior IT Program Manager provides direction to the project managers, business analysts, and vendor delivery teams assigned to each initiative, serve as the primary escalation point below executive leadership, and is accountable for delivering the program on schedule, within scope, and within budget.

  

· At a high level, the resource will provide strategic leadership and program oversight, applying senior-level management capabilities, executive communication, financial management, and vendor and contract coordination to support the delivery of complex technology initiatives. The program will encompass cloud-based vendor software, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) solutions, and custom development efforts delivered through Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.

  
  

### **Requirements**

• **Strategic program planning:** Develop and manage the program strategy, roadmap, integrated schedule, and governance framework collaboratively with leadership and in alignment with agency objectives.

• **Multi-project coordination:** Oversee multiple interconnected projects, managing the overall program plan, schedule cross-project dependencies, sequencing, and resource allocation.

• **Executive stakeholder management:** Present program status, risks, and recommendations to executive sponsors and governance bodies.

• **Cross-functional team leadership:** Direct and coordinate project managers and cross-functional business and technical teams, collaboratively and usually without direct authority.

• **Budget and resource management:** Monitor program budget and spend, optimize the allocation of staff and resources across projects, forecast and communicate program funding needs over the life of the program.

• **Risk and issue resolution:** Identify, assess, mitigate, and transparently escalate program-level risks, issues, and dependencies, using the processes established in the program governance model.

• **Vendor and partner management:** Oversee vendor performance against contracted scope, schedule, and deliverables, and maintain accurate records of vendor commitments and performance.

• **Change management:** Coordinate with organizational change management to prepare IT staff and business areas to adopt new systems and processes.

• **Performance measurement:** Establish program measures and deliver regular, objective reporting on program health and progress.

• **Process improvement:** Identify and implement program and project management best practices, consistent with agency and state IT standards.

• **Provide knowledge transfer.**

  

**Desired** **Skills**

• Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, public administration, or a related field.

• Ten or more years of project and program management experience, including at least five years leading multi-project programs in a matrixed environment, directing project managers and cross-functional business and technical teams without direct authority.

• Active PMP or PgMP certification.

• Two or more years of experience in corrections, public safety, or justice, either in government or with a vendor serving those agencies.

• Experience leading a legacy system replacement or commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) implementation through go-live, including data conversion, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization.

• Experience managing program financials, including budget tracking against actuals, spend forecasting across multiple fiscal years, variance analysis, and reporting to sponsors and finance.

• Experience managing resource capacity across multiple concurrent projects, including allocating staff and contractors and forecasting future resource needs.

• Experience building and maintaining an integrated program schedule, including cross-project dependencies, sequencing, and critical path management.

• Experience owning program-level risk and issue management (RAID), including assessment, mitigation planning, and escalation through a formal governance structure.

• Experience producing recurring program status and health reporting with defined metrics, and presenting status, risks, and recommendations for decision to executive sponsors and steering committees.

• Experience managing vendor performance against contracted scope, schedule, and deliverables, including tracking vendor commitments and resolving performance issues.

• Experience leading data governance, analytics, or data platform initiatives.

• Experience coordinating external program or project audits, including audit responses and corrective action plans.

• Experience managing hybrid Agile and waterfall delivery within a single program.

• Experience partnering with organizational change management to drive adoption of new systems and processes.

• Experience developing business cases and financial models for technology investments.

• MBA or other advanced degree.

  

**The work is expected to be done remotely.**

Under limited supervision, manages projects through the full life cycle from project definition and approval through implementation and evaluation of all project deliverables. Provides guidance to the project team. May also serve in a lead role.

**Complete Description:**

It is a multi-year program to replace the current institutional legacy systems for human capital management and financials improving the experience for students, faculty, and staff; streamlining core business processes; and unifying technology into a single, Software as a Service (SaaS) solution. This position is one of four limited term positions which there will be an active recruitment process. jobs.description:
**Job title:** Program Manager - Product Launch Delivery

**Reports to:** Staff Technical Program Manager

**Department:** Central Services

**Location:** Alpharetta, GA/Remote

**Grade:** 19

**About Priority:**

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** - bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

**About the Role:**

This role owns a multi-project program within one of the product workstreams — Banking and Treasury, Priority Commerce Engine, Merchant and Partner Solutions, or a Core Platform Shared Services domain such as billing or payment rails. You will coordinate several concurrent projects and their interdependencies across engineering, product, and operations, holding one plan and one version of status for the program.

This is an individual contributor role within the Enterprise PMO's Product Launch Delivery tower. It owns how the work ships, not what ships or how it is architected. The role reports to the tower's Delivery Lead and works to the methodology and reporting standards set by PMO Operations and CoE. Customer implementations sit in a separate tower, and product-facing software delivery sits in Product Launch Delivery.

**Responsibilities:**

* Owns delivery of a multi-project program within an assigned product workstream, including schedule, scope integrity, and dependency management across its constituent projects.
* Maintains the program plan, milestones, critical path, and RAID log, and keeps them current enough to be used for decisions rather than for reporting.
* Coordinates cross-functional delivery across engineering, product, quality, and operations to a shared date.
* Produces effort and duration estimates for planned work, and flags feasibility before a date is committed.
* Runs the delivery cadence for the program: planning, standing reviews, dependency checkpoints, and escalation.
* Manages release entry and exit criteria for the program's releases, partnering with Release Coordination on deployment readiness.
* Carries regulatory and control requirements as plan items where the program touches SOC 2 or PCI DSS scope.
* Reports program status through the EPMO Intelligence Portal to the standards set by PMO Operations and CoE.
* Mentors project managers and associate project managers working within the program.
* Contributes patterns and lessons learned to the launch playbook through the quarterly pattern loop.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* The program delivers to its committed dates, and slippage is forecast rather than discovered.
* Dependencies between the program's projects are visible and sequenced, not resolved by escalation.
* Engineering and product partners work from one plan and one version of status.
* Scope changes arrive through a defined route with effort and date impact attached, rather than as verbal commitments.
* Release readiness is evidenced, and post-release defects are the exception.
* Project managers in the program grow measurably against the next level's scope.

**Candidate Requirements:**

**Required**

* 6–8 years in project or program management, including ownership of a multi-project program with interdependencies.
* Experience delivering software or platform work across more than one engineering team.
* Working fluency with integration and release mechanics: environments, dependency sequencing, release criteria, and UAT.
* Demonstrated cross-functional coordination without direct authority.
* Disciplined execution mechanics: an honest critical path, actively used RAID logs, and status reporting leadership can act on.
* Experience in a regulated delivery environment such as SOC 2 or PCI DSS.
* Fluency with both agile and waterfall delivery approaches.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred**

* PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM certification.
* Payments or fintech domain exposure: acquiring, banking and treasury, payables, billing, or payment rails.
* Experience working with an offshore development team.
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Ai tooling.
* Exposure to Lean or Six Sigma methods applied to cycle-time reduction.

**Work Environment & Culture:**

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand - *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

**Compensation range:** [$120k-$145k]  
We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Join a company that’s quietly powering thousands of businesses**

Behind every thriving law firm, accounting practice, and healthcare provider is software doing the heavy lifting, and there’s a good chance it’s ours. ProfitSolv is a fast-growing SaaS company delivering billing, payments, and practice management solutions to the professionals who keep our communities running. Our products are trusted by tens of thousands of firms, and our team is the reason why.

We’re a company of builders and problem-solvers: around 300 people who care about the craft, back each other up, and celebrate the wins together. If you want your work to be visible, valued, and genuinely fun, you’ll fit right in.

We’re hiring a **Project Manager** to help us grow, and to grow with us.

**The role**

As our **Project Manager**, you’ll deliver projects on time, on budget, in scope, and to the right quality standard, guiding each one from detailed planning through full handover to the business. You’ll report to the Project Owner and work hand in hand with your project team, key stakeholders, and our Project Management Office.

* Manage day-to-day project operations, keeping scope, schedule, cost, and quality on track at every stage
* Lead your assigned project team to hit deliverables and realize the expected business benefits
* Monitor costs with your controller and review invoices to make sure payments never get ahead of the work
* Partner with stakeholders and sub-project teams to keep interfaces aligned and resolve cross-functional issues at the project level
* Keep stakeholders informed through regular status meetings and reports
* Prepare and deliver change requests through our standard change control process
* Identify, track, and resolve project issues, escalating to the Program Owner and Steering Committee when needed
* Own project documentation, formal communication, sign-off, and final archiving
* Run your projects under our Project Process, with support and oversight from the PMO

You’ll handle confidential information with care, following established security policies and procedures.

**What makes you a great fit**

* A proven track record of successfully delivering medium to large projects
* Experience managing projects in complex software application environments
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams of internal and external experts
* Strong planning skills, including hands-on use of MS Project and project controlling tools
* Comfort working in a matrix reporting environment with a wide range of stakeholders
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict management skills
* Sound, timely decision-making and the ability to set priorities when everything feels urgent
* A drive for results, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to motivate the people around you
* Cultural awareness and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams
* A commitment to your own growth and to seeing every project through

**What we offer**

* Performance-based compensation: your results are recognized and rewarded
* 401(k) with company match
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, including HSA and FSA options
* Generous paid time off and paid holidays
* Fully remote work
* A collaborative, high-trust team of smart, curious, hardworking people

**About ProfitSolv**

ProfitSolv is the SaaS company behind the tools that thousands of law firms, accounting practices, and healthcare providers rely on every day: billing, payments, and practice management software that helps professionals get paid faster and run smarter businesses. We’re fully remote across the US, seriously invested in our people, and just getting started.

This role involves prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer, the ability to lift up to 15 pounds at times, and travel as needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

**Our commitment to you**

This is a remote role outside of required onsite work for 1-2 weeks per month. Travel is expected 1-2 times per month.

As a Senior Project Manager - Healthcare IT on the Cyber Strategy & Transformation team, you will be responsible for:

* Develop and maintain the integrated project plan and delivery cadence, tracking scope, schedule, and quality expectations.
* Identify, track, and drive resolution of risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate decisions and blockers as needed.

* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

TISTA is seeking an **Associate Project Manag**er to provide project implementation support for a VA logistics software application on the Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program. Working under the direction of a senior team member, the Associate PM will help plan, coordinate, and track the activities needed to deploy new capabilities and keep the application running. These activities include release and deployment planning, site and user readiness, training, go-live support, and post-implementation follow-up. This role suits an early-career professional who is organized, communicates clearly, and wants to grow in federal health IT implementation and project management.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

**TISTA** associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!

Responsibilities:

***Implementation Planning and Coordination***

* Assist in developing and maintaining implementation plans, deployment schedules, cutover plans, and milestone trackers for patches, releases, and modernization increments.
* Coordinate implementation activities among MUMPS developers, Java/React developers, business analysts, testers, infrastructure and operations teams, and VA stakeholders.
* Track tasks, dependencies, and deliverables, and follow up with team members to resolve blockers before deployment dates.
* Schedule and facilitate implementation meetings, readiness checkpoints, and go/no-go reviews, and capture agendas, minutes, decisions, and action items.
* Support resource planning and capacity tracking in coordination with team leads.

***Deployment, Release, and Go-Live Support***

* Coordinate patch and release schedules with operations, testing, change management, and facility or site points of contact.
* Help prepare and track release readiness checklists, change requests, deployment runbooks, and rollback plans.
* Support go-live activities, including communication of deployment windows, real-time status tracking, and issue escalation.
* Capture post-deployment results, lessons learned, and follow-up actions, and report them to the senior PM and product owner.
* Track incident, defect, and enhancement ticket volumes and aging after deployment to identify implementation-related issues and trends.

***Modernization Implementation Support***

* Monitor progress of modernization work streams, including API development, UI development, authentication integration, and data migration, and flag schedule or scope concerns that could affect implementation.
* Support coordination of integration, environment, and testing activities across teams and external VA partners.
* Track transition tasks that move users and functions from legacy components to modernized ones, and help manage related dependencies.

***Risk, Issue, and Reporting Management***

* Maintain the risk, issue, assumption, and dependency (RAID) logs for implementation activities, and escalate items as appropriate.
* Prepare weekly status reports, dashboards, and metrics (e.g., milestone status, deployment success rates, burn-down) for project leadership.
* Assist with budget and invoice tracking, level-of-effort reporting, and contract deliverable monitoring as needed.

***Agile and Governance Support***

* Support Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives, and maintain Jira boards and Confluence pages.
* Help prepare project artifacts required by VA software development lifecycle processes and team procedures
* Maintain a well-organized project repository of plans, decisions, and records.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Information Systems, Project Management, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience may substitute on a year-for-year basis.
* 3 years of experience in project coordination, implementation support, project management support, or a related role.
* Basic understanding of project management concepts, including scope, schedule, risk, and communication management.
* Familiarity with Agile or Scrum concepts and with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, or similar.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Teams.

**About Nebius:**

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

**The role**

**Project manager**

Projects Manager delivers cross-functional projects that improve logistics systems, processes and ways of working across transportation and warehousing. The role turns business needs into scoped projects, leads them to go-live with IT, vendors and operations, and makes sure the results are adopted and measured.

**Typical projects**

* System enhancements: NetSuite logistics workflows, WMS/TMS rollout phases, planning tool implementation, Project44 / tracking integrations, Jira workflow redesign.
* Process redesign: PO-to-receipt flow, customs and export-licensing process, RMA flow, invoice-to-payment for logistics partners, SOX controls in logistics.
* Transport improvements: forwarder tendering process, shipment visibility, security protocols for high-value shipments, insurance claims flow.
* Warehouse and 3PL improvements delivered together with the Warehouse Projects Manager.

**Fit within the Project Office**

**Role**

**Focus**

Logistics Projects Manager

Cross-functional system and process projects across transport and warehousing

Warehouse Projects Manager

Warehouse operations optimisation: layout, productivity, site standards

Process Automation Specialist

Small automations: scripts, RPA, tools between systems

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Portfolio Intake & Prioritisation**

* Collect improvement requests and pain points from Transportation, Warehouse, 3PL, Planning and Back Office leads.
* Shape them into project proposals with scope, expected benefit, cost, effort and risk.
* Maintain the Project Office roadmap and prioritise it with the Head of Project Office and Head of Logistics.

* **Business Analysis & Solution Design**

* Map current processes (as-is), find root causes of issues and design the future state (to-be).
* Write business requirements and user stories for system changes; agree acceptance criteria with process owners.
* Evaluate options: configure existing systems, build small tools, buy a solution, or change the process only.

* **System Projects**

* Lead logistics system projects with IT and vendors: ERP (NetSuite), WMS/TMS, planning tool, tracking and integrations.
* Own the logistics side of vendor selection, solution design, UAT, data migration, cut-over and hypercare.
* Manage the backlog of logistics change requests in core systems after go-live.

* **Process Projects**

* Redesign end-to-end processes across teams (e.g. PO-to-receipt, RMA, customs, partner invoicing) and write SOPs and RACI.
* Embed controls needed for SOX and audit readiness into new processes.
* Standardise processes across regions (EMEA, US, APAC).

* **Project Delivery**

* Plan and run projects: scope, milestones, RAID log, budget, resources, dependencies.
* Coordinate project teams across logistics, IT, Finance, Procurement, Security and external vendors.
* Report status, risks and decisions to the Head of Project Office and steering committees.

* **Change Management & Adoption**

* Prepare teams for go-live: communication, training, Key User network, updated SOPs.
* Support teams after go-live until the new system or process runs stably.

* **Benefits Tracking**

* Define baseline and target KPIs for each project; track realised benefits after go-live.
* Run post-implementation reviews and share lessons learned.

* **Project Office Standards**

* Apply and improve Project Office templates: project charter, business case, status report, RAID, closure report.
* Coordinate with the Warehouse Projects Manager and Process Automation Specialist to avoid overlaps and reuse solutions.

  

**Expectations**

* **Autonomy:** Owns assigned projects end to end; escalates scope, budget and priority conflicts to the Head of Project Office.
* **Impact:** Makes logistics systems and processes scalable as Nebius grows its data center footprint.
* **Leadership:** Leads cross-functional project teams and vendors; no direct reports at start.
* **Travel:** Occasional trips to warehouses, sites and vendor locations for workshops and go-lives.

**Benefits & Perks:**

* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams

**What's it like to work at Nebius:**

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.description:
Eaton Corporate is seeking a Computerized Maintenance Management Systems - **CMMS Master Data Analyst.** This role may be remote with the US and requires global travel.

Reporting to the MES Process Owner - Maintenance, our CMMS Master Data Analyst will lead the analysis, cleansing, and standardization of maintenance data, including spare parts data, across all CMMS-enabled sites and source systems. You will use your knowledge of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) and CMMS/EAM systems (eMaint, Maximo Faciliworks, or similar) to support CMMS implementation and deployment projects across manufacturing sites.

**In this role you will:**  

* Support manufacturing sites in the generation, collection, validation, cleansing, standardization, and preparation of master data maintenance for upload into the CMMS.
* Identifying duplicate records, inconsistent naming conventions, missing attributes, data quality issues affecting CMMS performance, and opportunities for consolidation and continuous improvement.
* Develop and maintain global taxonomies, classification structures, and standardized naming conventions for spare parts and other maintenance master data to ensure consistency across all manufacturing sites and business units.
* Create, govern, and maintain enterprise master data repositories serving as the single source of truth for maintenance information, including asset and equipment records, functional locations, bills of materials (BOMs), preventive maintenance data, and a master spare parts database covering part numbers, descriptions, classifications, and attributes.
* Support CMMS implementation and deployment projects by coordinating data collection, validation, migration, governance, and readiness activities for sites transitioning to the enterprise CMMS platform, with a strong focus on spare parts and maintenance master data quality.

* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, KPIs, and data quality metrics to monitor data completeness, accuracy, standardization, governance compliance, taxonomy adoption, duplicate elimination, and continuous improvement opportunities across sites.
* Collaborate with site maintenance teams to generate, validate, and enrich maintenance and spare parts data, identify local variations, and align data to enterprise standards and taxonomy requirements for CMMS deployment and ongoing operations.
* Work with Maintenance, Procurement, Inventory Management, Engineering, and Operations teams to align master data standards with business objectives, maintenance excellence, inventory optimization, strategic sourcing, and operational reliability goals.
* Lead the definition and future integration strategy between CMMS and ERP master data, including data ownership, mapping standards, synchronization rules, and interface requirements, to ensure seamless information flow across systems.
* Train and support site stakeholders on CMMS master data standards, spare parts classification methodologies, data governance requirements, data collection methodologies, and CMMS data entry best practices.

**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain Management, or related technical field.
* Minimum 2 to 5 years of experience in data analysis, master data management, or CMMS/ERP administration.

* Experience in master data management, data governance, data quality, cleansing, standardization, and migration activities within manufacturing or maintenance environments.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Location:** US (Remote); preference for candidates on Eastern Time

**Compensation:** $80,000 - $90,000 per year + Stock Options

##### **About Argyle**

Argyle is a fast-growing, remote-first, Series C startup solving a consumer data problem.

For decades, financial service providers and other businesses have collected and verified consumer income, employment, and asset data the same way: by hand or via verification databases. These methods are expensive, time consuming, high friction, and/or unreliable. In turn, experiences like applying for a loan or completing a background check are challenging for service providers and consumers alike.

The solution is Argyle. We’re the leading provider of direct-source, consumer-permissioned income, employment, and asset verifications. We make it fast and easy to gain secure and reliable access to the most complete real-time datasets stored in consumers’ payroll and banking accounts, so service providers can automate verification workflows, save time, reduce risks, lower costs, and build better product experiences.

Named one of America’s Best Startup Employers of 2026 by Forbes, Argyle largely serves the mortgage, government benefits, tenant screening, lending, and background check industries as well as the gig economy.

Founded in 2018, Argyle’s commitment to innovation is backed by investors including Bain Capital Ventures, Checkr, Mastercard, Rockefeller Asset Management and SignalFire.

##### **About the team**

Revenue Operations runs the critical business operations that keep Argyle’s sales motion moving fast, from deal approvals and contracting to billing, commissions, and the CRM. We’re a small team of experienced operators, and we lean heavily on automation and AI tools to do more with less.

This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who wants to learn from an experienced RevOps team and own real processes within a few months. You’ll work daily with account executives, customer success managers, marketing, and finance.

##### **What You’ll Do**

* **Be the first stop for RevOps requests.** Own the request queue for Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Handle the routine work yourself, from contract amendments and exports to pricing reviews, SKU setup, and Salesforce cleanup. On every request, engage stakeholders and pressure-test their asks until you land on a solution or a clear escalation path.
* **Own monthly billing preparation.** Run most of the pre-invoice process each month, from custom billing processes, credits tracking, and discrepancies review to finalizing amounts each customer owes.
* **Build controls that scale.** Run recurring checks that signed contracts, billing setup, and platform access line up, and turn repeat requests into documented processes or automation, including AI-assisted workflows.
* **Handle routine deal desk approvals.** Review opportunities in Salesforce for completeness, pricing setup, and contract dates before approval, and resolve setup issues that slow deals down.
* **Manage the customer account lifecycle.** Handle activations, terminations, reinstatements, and access changes, and keep Salesforce and our billing platform in sync.
* **Keep CRM data clean.** Maintain accounts, contacts, ownership, and pipeline hygiene. Monitor the health of the HubSpot–Salesforce sync to ensure a smooth handoff from Marketing to Sales.
* **Support partner and government reporting.** Help prepare monthly and quarterly revenue share reports for channel and integration partners, plus recurring reporting on our government contracts.
* **Co-own sales commissions.** Learn our monthly commission process hands-on, then share ownership of running it each month, from calculating payouts to keeping the process accurate and on time.

##### **What Success Looks Like**

* **Month 1:** You’ve worked through a full billing cycle and the request queue alongside the team, and you’ve shadowed the monthly commissions process.
* **Month 2:** You own most of billing preparation and routine requests on your own, and you’ve used AI tools to automate your first repetitive steps.
* **Month 3:** You own all billing preparation, serve as the front line for the RevOps request queue, and co-own the monthly commission process.
* **Ongoing:** You’re the first response to GTM requests and resolve most of them yourself. You run the monthly pre-invoice process and own key communications between GTM and Finance throughout. With the time AI automation frees up, you spend more of your month on higher-level business analysis.

##### **What We’re Looking For**

* 1–3 years in revenue operations or sales operations, ideally at a B2B SaaS business
* Comfort working in Salesforce day to day, from building reports and updating records in bulk to troubleshooting validation rules
* Experience building reports in Looker or another BI tool, and turning that data into analyses that solve real business problems
* Strong spreadsheet skills, including lookups, pivots, and reconciling data across sources
* A high bar for accuracy and attention to detail, since you’ll work with the contract, billing, and commissions data behind our revenue
* Interest in using AI tools to automate repetitive work
* Clear written communication with internal teams and customers
* **Nice to have:** Salesforce Administrator certification; familiarity with HubSpot; exposure to mortgage, lending, or fintech

##### **Why Argyle?**

* **Remote-first.** Join a globally distributed team.
* **Strong teammates.** Work alongside smart, thoughtful, and ambitious people who genuinely care about delivering best-in-class service.
* **High standards, low ego.** We hold ourselves to a high bar and keep egos out of it.
* **Real ownership.** Everyone owns meaningful work and has the flexibility to work in a way that suits them.
* **Inclusive by design.** We’re intentional about building a team where different backgrounds and perspectives lead to better ideas and stronger collaboration.

Description:

OHG Brands is home to America’s original, iconic restaurant brands. The company strategically develops and grows a diverse portfolio of fast-casual, quick-service and casual dining concepts around the world, using brand heritage as the foundation for growth and innovation that resonates with the next generation of fans. OHG Brands currently operates 12 restaurant brands: Round Table Pizza, Fatburger, Marble Slab Creamery, Johnny Rockets, Fazoli’s, Great American Cookies, Buffalo’s Cafe & Express, Hurricane Grill & Wings, Native Grill & Wings, Pretzelmaker, and Ponderosa and Bonanza Steakhouses, and franchises and owns over 1,700 units worldwide.

We are looking for an Operations Analyst, Performance Analytics. As the Operations Analyst, you will be the analytical partner to Operations and the field, connecting audit, guest, sales and traffic data to show what drives store results and which stores need help.

What you’ll do:  

* Build the operations views of the Store Scorecard and the weekly reporting field teams use to decide where to go.
* Report on third-party food safety and brand standards audits (such as Steritech): scores, trends, repeat failures and open corrective actions.
* Analyze guest surveys and online and delivery-app reviews for the themes driving store performance.
* Build the field visit tracker: visits against plan, visit scores and open actions.
* Follow up with field consultants and franchisees on stores that are missing, late or have gone dark, so the store list stays complete.
* Over time, build the franchisee health view and track new stores against each brand’s ramp curve.
* Document your work, and use AI tools every day, checking the output before it is used.

In your first 90 days: Operations reporting is in weekly use and every store that has gone dark has a confirmed status.

Requirements:

* 2+ years in analytics, reporting or insights, ideally supporting operations, field teams, quality or customer experience.
* Experience analyzing survey, review, audit or operational performance data, with sound judgment about small samples; you can turn a pile of comments or audit findings into a few themes leaders can act on, backed by numbers.
* Strong Excel and Power BI, strong PowerPoint, and working proficiency with Word, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint; working SQL on a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.
* Regular, hands-on use of AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot) for real work, with good judgment about checking the output and handling guest and franchisee data.
* You connect store-level data from different sources and know when a comparison isn’t fair (store age, size, sample, a partial week).
* A clear communicator with Operations, field and senior leaders, with discretion on sensitive audit and franchisee information, and persistent, courteous follow-up until an issue is closed.
* Drive: you turn data into action, follow through, and are comfortable building without a playbook.
* A track record of documenting your work so others can pick it up.

  

Preferred:  

* Experience analyzing audit, inspection or quality assurance data (food safety audits preferred).
* Restaurant, franchise or multi-unit experience, or time in restaurant operations (for example as a general manager or area manager).
* Experience with a guest feedback platform, public review sites, or franchisee P&L and royalty reporting.

**Job Description:**

CSI is seeking a **Senior Data Analyst, Payments Reporting** to join our Qolo Data Operations team. This is a highly technical, hands-on role focused on building and supporting financial and transactional reporting for our payments platform.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Database Administration, and Finance Operations to develop accurate reporting, investigate transaction and balance discrepancies, and optimize SQL queries supporting high-volume payment and ledger data. You’ll also play an important role in enterprise client launches by translating reporting requirements into reliable, production-ready solutions

This role is ideal for someone who combines advanced SQL expertise with strong financial-data knowledge and enjoys digging into complex reporting and reconciliation issues to determine what’s happening behind the numbers.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build, maintain, and enhance financial and transactional reports supporting Qolo clients and internal teams.
* Develop and optimize complex SQL Server and T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and reporting processes.
* Translate reporting requirements into functional reports for new enterprise client implementations.
* Investigate reporting discrepancies, including missing transactions, balance mismatches, duplicate postings, timing differences, and pending versus posted transactions.
* Support financial reconciliation by comparing authorizations, settlements, and ledger postings and identifying variances.
* Troubleshoot slow-running or timing-out reports and partner with DBAs and Engineering to improve query performance.
* Analyze execution plans and address indexing, locking, blocking, and other database-performance issues.
* Document reporting logic, data sources, and business rules.
* Work closely with Product to understand reporting needs and support larger technical initiatives.
* Partner with developers and technical teams when reporting functionality requires broader application or system changes.
* Clearly communicate findings and financial-data discrepancies to both technical and nontechnical partners.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience in data analysis, BI, database reporting, or a related technical reporting role.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL, including complex joins, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures, dynamic SQL, temp tables, and error handling.
* Strong SQL performance-tuning skills, including experience with execution plans, indexing, statistics, and troubleshooting slow-running queries.
* Strong understanding of database fundamentals, data modeling, data integrity, and large transactional datasets.
* Experience building, scheduling, and supporting production reporting processes.
* Experience working with financial or transactional data where accuracy across amounts, balances, dates, and reporting periods is critical.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or another financial-services environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify the root cause of complex data discrepancies.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to nontechnical business partners.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, database, and operational teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of card and payment processing, including authorization, clearing, settlement, interchange, and chargebacks.
* Experience with ledger, transaction, or balance reconciliation.
* Familiarity with Azure and cloud-based data environments.
* Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, or similar BI/reporting tools.

jobs.title: Senior Payroll Data Analyst | Remote
jobs.description:
At Crescent Hotels & Resorts, we bring a bold strategy and innovative spirit to everything we do. As one of North America’s leading hotel management companies, our success is driven by talented associates who value collaboration, accountability, and meaningful impact. Our corporate teams work behind the scenes to support hotels and associates across our portfolio, providing the expertise, tools, and insights needed to strengthen our organization and help our properties thrive.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Payroll Data Analyst** to join our corporate Payroll team. Reporting to the **Vice President, Corporate Payroll**, this position will focus on payroll and workforce data analysis, reporting, auditing, systems support, testing, and process improvement. The role helps protect data integrity, support compliance, and improve operational effectiveness across payroll and workforce management systems.

This individual will be an important resource for Payroll, People & Culture, Finance, Operations, and property-level partners. The Senior Payroll Specialist will validate data, identify trends and exceptions, develop reporting solutions, support system enhancements, and translate complex payroll and workforce information into clear, actionable insights.

This is not a traditional payroll-processing position or a software development role. It is a business-focused opportunity centered on payroll-supporting technology, workforce data, reporting, auditing, controls, and process improvement. Experience with **UKG Pro** and **UKG Workforce Management** is strongly preferred.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Analyze payroll, workforce, and associate data to identify trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and maintain recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, queries, data extracts, and audit tools.
* Conduct regular audits and validations to help ensure payroll and workforce data is accurate, consistent, and aligned with company standards.
* Investigate discrepancies involving employee setup, timekeeping, pay calculations, labor allocations, accruals, job data, and other payroll-impacting fields.
* Partner with Payroll, People & Culture, Finance, IT, Operations, property teams, and external vendors to resolve issues and improve processes.
* Support **UKG Pro** and **UKG Workforce Management** processes, including reporting, data-flow validation, testing, and business-process support.

* Create testing scenarios, perform unit testing, participate in user acceptance testing, and document results for system changes, upgrades, integrations, and process updates.
* Establish and maintain controls, audit procedures, documentation, and reporting processes that strengthen payroll and workforce data integrity.
* Prepare summaries, presentations, and recommendations for Payroll leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Provide advanced data and systems support to Payroll and property users.
* Contribute to training materials, process documentation, and knowledge-based resources.
* Support payroll audits, compliance requests, year-end activities, system implementations, and special projects as needed.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Human Resources, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Five or more years of experience in payroll, workforce management, business analytics, reporting, data integrity, or a related function.
* Strong experience analyzing large data sets and translating findings into clear, practical recommendations.
* Advanced proficiency in **Microsoft Excel**, including PivotTables, advanced formulas, data validation, data cleanup, and report preparation.
* Experience with **Power Query** is preferred.
* Experience with **UKG Pro** is preferred.

* Experience supporting system testing, imports, upgrades, process improvements, and cross-functional projects.

* The ability to explain complex data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, compliance, and confidentiality.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

jobs.description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

**Job Summary**

Across the healthcare industry nationwide, hospitals and health systems face challenges to today’s approaches to expense management, as revenue growth has not kept pace with expense growth. In response to these unprecedented external challenges, MGB launched Sustain in fall of 2023. Sustain is an ongoing organization-wide program that works to build an infrastructure, culture, and mindset around continuous improvement, working to preserve our four-part mission through focus on resource stewardship. To do this, while also funding needed capital maintenance and improvements to deliver on world-class patient care, research, education, and community health, we must seek out innovative opportunities to optimize the way we work and manage resources across our organization.  
  
The Sustain Analytics team is part of the Business Planning department, which also includes Decision Support and Business Analytics teams. The Business Analyst (Finance), on the Sustain Analytics team is responsible for supporting a broad range of analytic, planning, benchmarking, and other operational support activities for one or more designated members of the Leadership Team (Senior VP’s, Clinical VP’s, Operating VP’s and Executive Directors), across the enterprise, under the guidance of senior team members.
  
  
A critical measure of each Business Analyst’s success will be the extent to which the analytic and planning needs of each person supported are met in a timely, consistent, high quality manner. This will require close collaboration with staff within the clinical departments, and many other analytic, financial, and planning groups throughout the MGB enterprise, including Sustain Management Office (SMO), Business Planning, Financial Planning, Digital, and local financial, operational, and analytical teams and decision-making bodies at each of the MGB entities. An ability to synthesize, summarize and effectively communicate the analytic and planning work that is performed is key.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Academic experience focused in finance, financial analytics, data analytics, and/or operations management
* 2+ years of healthcare, financial, or business analysis experience required
* Experience in materials management analytics, clinical supply utilization analytics, surgical capacity, and/or data analytics preferred; relevant internship or co-op experience will be considered
* Experience working in a health system, hospital and/or similar medical center environment preferred.

* + Utilize industry benchmarks to compare cost, profitability, utilization, and pricing for procedural cases and clinical supplies
* Support the development of consistent executive level reporting, to be used by clinical and administrative leaders within the perioperative and procedural areas, to measure performance and support best practice across the enterprise
* Help catalogue current state analytics across various systems, and support the development of standard analytics and reporting in one single system to meet varied stakeholder needs across the enterprise
* Escalate challenges, discrepancies, roadblocks regarding data and analytics to manager or appropriate data owner

* Assist in creating deliverables for executive and c-suite level leadership, summarizing performance and related comments from local entities and departments
* + Support ad hoc inquiries and analytics from department leaders
* Support leadership across Business Planning, Digital, and Perioperative Leadership with routine system maintenance and upgrades

**Communication Activities**

* Prepare concise, clear, professional summaries of analyses and plans for review by senior team members and Senior Leadership, as appropriate.
* Present findings to staff and stakeholders, targeting the presentation towards the knowledge level and needs of the audience

At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

  

Compass is building the first modern end-to-end real estate platform, integrating agents, buyers, and sellers through technology.

The security organization protects that platform and the people who use it. We run identity, detection and response, vulnerability management, and compliance across a growing portfolio of businesses and brands, and we are bringing them onto one security operating model.

As Staff Technical Program Manager for Information Security, you own the programs that bring identity, attack surface, detection and response, vulnerability management, and compliance onto one measurable operating model across Compass. You will work across organizations that do not report to you, on problems that arrive without a plan attached, setting the sequence, naming the tradeoff, and bringing leadership a recommendation rather than a status update. This is a senior individual contributor role.

**At Compass You Will:**
------------------------

* Own the portfolio of highest-ambiguity security programs across Compass, spanning multiple organizations on a 12 to 18 month horizon, and set the plan where one does not yet exist.
* Lead security integration programs across existing and newly acquired Compass businesses, bringing security tooling, policy, and data onto a common standard.

We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products.
