jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Business Analyst) – Financial Management & Banking Accounting
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Within our IT consulting firm, we support major banking and financial groups in the evolution, governance, and modernization of their financial and accounting information systems. To strengthen the teams of the General Secretariat of a leading financial services provider, we are seeking a Senior Project Manager (Business Analyst) – Financial Management. You will be involved in the development of applications dedicated to financial management, accounting, and finance, while also ensuring the cross-functional management of General Secretariat projects in close collaboration with business units and the IT department. This position is based in the Île-de-France region. YOUR MISSIONS: 1. Business Analyst – Financial Management & Accounting Applications - Scoping and Requirements Gathering: Analyze and formalize business requirements related to accounting, finance, and financial management applications. - Specifications and Data Models: Translate accounting and regulatory rules into detailed functional specifications based on existing banking data models. - Validation and Acceptance Testing: Manage the functional approval phases, ensure compliance of changes, and guarantee the quality of the data produced. 2. Project Management & Business Intelligence Reporting - Cross-Functional Coordination: Manage the General Secretariat's projects from start to finish by coordinating the various stakeholders (business teams, accounting, management control, IT, and software vendors). - Data-Driven Management (KPIs): Design, structure, and ensure the reliability of dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and regulatory or management reports. - Governance: Lead monitoring meetings, track schedules, and raise alerts regarding risks and necessary trade-offs.

**Desired profile**
-------------------

Expérience Senior : Minimum 8 ans d'expérience en Maîtrise d'Ouvrage (MOA) et/ou gestion de projet SI dans le secteur bancaire ou financier. Expertise Comptable & Bancaire : Excellente compréhension des métiers bancaires, des instruments financiers et de leur traitement dans les systèmes d'information (aspects comptables et réglementaires). Environnement Bancaire Mutualiste : Une connaissance approfondie des modèles de données et des architectures SI d'un grand groupe bancaire mutualiste est fortement attendue. Compétences techniques & outils : - Gestion de Projet : Expérience avérée dans le pilotage de projets complexes impliquant de multiples parties prenantes. - Reporting & Data : Expérience confirmée dans la création, la structuration et la gestion de reportings, tableaux de bord et KPI. - Culture Technique : Bonne maîtrise des outils de développement et de requêtage permettant de dialoguer efficacement avec la DSI et d'explorer les données. Soft Skills : - Rigueur analytique, esprit de synthèse et grande précision dans le maniement des données comptables et financières. - Excellentes capacités relationnelles et posture de facilitateur pour fédérer les équipes métiers et informatiques. - Autonomie, sens des responsabilités et proactivité. Vous souhaitez mettre votre double expertise financière et MOA au service d'un acteur bancaire de premier plan ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui !

jobs.title: Stage - Data Analyst - Data Visualisation - H/F
jobs.description:
**BNP Paribas Leasing Solutions** est le métier spécialisé dans les solutions de financement locatif d’équipements professionnels et immobiliers. Présent dans 20 pays, il accompagne les entreprises dans le développement de leurs activités grâce à l’expertise de près de 3 700 collaborateurs.

Au sein de la Fonction RISK de BNP Paribas Leasing Solutions, vous rejoindrez l’équipe **Scoring & Provisioning Models**. Cette équipe est notamment chargée de la conception, de la maintenance et de l’industrialisation des modèles quantitatifs utilisés pour évaluer le risque de crédit, tant dans le cadre de l’octroi que du provisionnement.

**AU QUOTIDIEN ÇA DONNE QUOI ?**
--------------------------------

Dans un contexte de renforcement des outils de pilotage, vous contribuerez à la conception et à l’industrialisation d’un dispositif de suivi des ratings des partenaires. Vous participerez également à l’amélioration et à la sécurisation de l’environnement Power BI de l’équipe.

**À ce titre, vous serez amené à :**

* Recueillir et formaliser les besoins des utilisateurs en matière d’indicateurs, d’axes d’analyse, de filtres et de fréquence de mise à jour ;
* Identifier, consolider et contrôler les différentes sources de données nécessaires au suivi des ratings partenaires ;
* Définir, en collaboration avec les équipes métiers, les indicateurs clés permettant notamment d’analyser la répartition et l’évolution des ratings, les migrations, les concentrations et la qualité des données ;
* Concevoir des tableaux de bord Power BI clairs, interactifs et adaptés aux différents niveaux de lecture, du suivi opérationnel à la synthèse managériale ;
* Automatiser les traitements, les contrôles et le rafraîchissement des données afin de fiabiliser les reportings et de réduire les opérations manuelles ;
* Documenter les sources de données, les règles de gestion, les indicateurs et les procédures de mise à jour ;
* Participer à l’administration de l’environnement Power BI, notamment à travers l’organisation des espaces de travail, la publication des tableaux de bord et le suivi de leur cycle de vie ;
* Contribuer à la gestion des accès, à la ségrégation des droits et à l’amélioration du processus d’habilitation.

**Votre stage se déroulera** dans les locaux de BNP Paribas Leasing Solutions, situés au **18 rue Baudin à Levallois-Perret**, à proximité du métro Pont de Levallois.

Ce stage est à pourvoir pour une **durée de 06 mois**, avec un démarrage souhaité en **mars ou avril 2027**.

**ET APRÈS ?**
--------------

Grâce à cette expérience, vous développerez vos compétences en matière de data visualisation, de data storytelling, de modélisation des données et d’automatisation des reportings. Vous approfondirez également votre compréhension des enjeux liés à la qualité des données, à la gouvernance des accès et au pilotage du risque de crédit.

D’autres opportunités pourront ensuite s’offrir à vous et favoriser votre insertion professionnelle :

* Le Graduate Programme vous permet de développer vos compétences et votre leadership grâce à des missions à responsabilité ;
* Le Volontariat International en Entreprise, ou VIE, vous offre la possibilité d’enrichir votre parcours grâce à une expérience internationale de 12 à 24 mois.

**LES AVANTAGES À NOUS REJOINDRE**
----------------------------------

Un package et des avantages :

* Une gratification mensuelle brute attractive, supérieure au minimum prévu par la loi, variable selon le niveau d’études et le diplôme préparé, **entre 1050€ et 1500 € dans le cadre d'un bac +4 et** **entre 1250€ et 2100€ dans le cadre d’un bac+5.**
* Un accès au restaurant d’entreprise ou à des tickets restaurant ;
* Des activités sociales et culturelles proposées par le comité social et économique.

Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau **Bac+4/5**, reconnu RNCP, au sein d’une école d’ingénieurs, d’une école de commerce ou d’une formation universitaire, avec une spécialisation en **data analyse, Business Intelligence, systèmes d’information, statistiques appliquées** ou dans un domaine équivalent.

Enfin, votre aisance relationnelle vous permettra de collaborer efficacement avec des équipes quantitatives, métiers et IT.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About Alma**

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

### **About the team**

Revenue at Alma covers the entire customer lifecycle, from lead generation to churn. It brings together Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management, representing more than 100 talented professionals.

Revenue Operations plays a key role in helping these teams work together around shared goals, reliable data and efficient processes. The team supports Revenue leaders in improving performance, making better decisions and scaling the organisation.

This position is a permanent contract, based in Paris, with 2 days of remote work per week.

You will report to Gaspard Zhâ, and work closely with Revenue teams, the Central Data Team, Ops & Risk, Product and Tech.

### **About the job**

As Business Analyst, Revenue Operations, you will create strategic insights that help Alma's Revenue teams understand their performance, identify growth opportunities and improve their speed and efficiency.

You will work at the intersection of data, business and strategy, turning complex questions into clear recommendations and practical tools.

Key responsibilities :

**Own the modelling / end-to-end pipeline for Revenue teams**

* Built models to answer the needs of revenue teams, by adding additional data sources
* Improve and maintain the existing models

**Feed our strategy and participate to its execution**

* Understand reasons of wins and how to win faster by making our data speak
* Design adhoc data driven tools and models to crack tactical business cases

**Improve performance monitoring and understanding of revenue growth dynamics**

* Build and manage dashboards and revenue forecasts so Revenue teams and leadership can easily understand business health and meet goals
* Support leaders of Revenue teams to set the right targets and follow the right KPIs

**Infuse data excellence**

* Driving a data culture inside revenue teams, leveraging data as to build unfair advantages
* Collaborate closely with the Central Data Team to maintain a high standard on data quality across the organization

### **You will work with**

SQL, Looker, LookML, Claude Code, Python, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, Rudderstack, Segment, Salesforce

### **About you**

To succeed in this job

* Strong proficiency in **SQL** and data modelling
* **2 to 4 years experience in data analysis/business analysis**, preferably in a fast-growing tech or fintech environment
* Strong proficiency in data visualisation, strong plus to have already work *with Looker & LookML*
* Genuine curiosity and eagerness to **work with AI-assisted tools** (Claude Code) as part of your daily workflo

And it will be nice if you also

* Are comfortable with **Python** for data manipulation and analysis
* Have hands-on experience with **dbt, BigQuery, or GCP**
* Have worked with **tracking tools** such as Rudderstack (or Segment)
* Hold a degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or similar

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

### **Your Alma experience**

The culture

At Alma, collective intelligence is at the heart of the way we work. We are building an international company in a fast-growing environment, where people are encouraged to take ownership, share ideas and learn from one another.

You will have access to our Learning & Development Platform, regular feedback and opportunities to develop your expertise and career path. As Alma continues to grow across Europe, you will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different teams, countries and areas of expertise.

We are committed to building a fair and inclusive workplace. We monitor our gender equality index and remain committed to pay equity, transparency and equal opportunities across the organisation.

The role itself

If you join Alma, you will be able to grow and have an impact by:

* Influencing strategic decisions across the full Revenue organisation, from lead generation to churn.
* Combining analytical depth, business understanding and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.
* Helping Revenue teams build a stronger data culture and create more efficient ways of working as Alma scales across Europe.

### **Compensation & benefits**

* **Competitive salary** based on 12 months
* **Profit-sharing and employee savings plan**
* **Health insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma, including family package
* **Disability insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma
* **Sport**: partnerships with **Gymlib** and **ClassPass**, or **€30/month** reimbursement for your sports activities
* **Maternity/paternity leave**: salary maintained at 100% during leave, with no seniority requirement. Return to work at a 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks
* **Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD)**: **€544.80/year**, excluding full-remote contracts
* **Meal vouchers**: **€10/day**, 50% covered by Alma
* **Mental health**: free access to the MindDay platform
* **Paid time off**: 25 days per year, plus additional paid leave granted to employees on executive contracts
* Access to our **Learning & Development Platform**
* **2 weeks of full remote work possible per year** during the summer

jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

jobs.title: Certification Operations and Policy Program Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Success - San Francisco

**About the Team**

Customer Education helps customers build the practical skills and confidence to use AI and OpenAI products safely and effectively. We bring together customer insight, learning and enablement expertise, product signals, and measurement to help organizations move from access to durable adoption.

Within Customer Education, the Certification team helps individuals demonstrate competence for in-demand AI skills and helps customers and partners validate that their workforce has the skills they need to meet their AI-enabled business goals. Our work centers on the belief that learners should understand where to go to build skills and capabilities, how to demonstrate them, and what to pursue next. Similarly, Enterprise leaders should understand what each credential signifies and how it supports workforce readiness. We do this with transparency for the overall OpenAI credential framework and providing trusted, role-based certifications that verify practical capability.

**About the Role**

As Certification Operations and Policy Program Manager, you will build and run the processes that make OpenAI certifications accessible, fair, and reliable for candidates and the organizations that rely on them.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role on the Certification team, with no direct reports. You will define candidate policies, turn them into practical processes, and own their implementation as the program grows. This is not a general program-management or support-only role: it combines policy development with hands-on operational delivery.

You will work closely with the Certification team, product and technical teams, Legal, Privacy, Security, Accessibility, Support, and delivery vendors to define operational standards and apply policies consistently and fairly. You will connect the partners needed to turn certification requirements into workable candidate processes.

You will start with early certification launches and build reusable playbooks, service standards, and review processes for live and virtual delivery. Initially, you will also triage escalated vendor and candidate cases, resolve routine delivery or credential-access issues, and route substantive appeals through the established independent-review process.

Success means candidates know what to expect, delivery partners know what to do when something goes wrong, and sensitive decisions are documented and independently reviewed.

**In this role, you will:**

* Define candidate-facing policies and communications across the certification journey, including eligibility, registration, exam rules, retakes, exceptions, expiration, and renewal. Partner with the Certification team to translate program requirements into policy and with Legal, product, technical teams, and vendors to build the processes that uphold it.
* Own the accommodations process from request through delivery. Work with Accessibilityation throughout.
* Own certification records and evidence workflows teams.
* Own vendor workflows and operational delivery standards, including handoffs, service levels, readiness checks, and escalation paths. Initially serve as the first point of contact for escalated delivery and credential-access cases, coordinating vendor fixes, candidate communications, and corrective actions.
* Coordinate the response to exam integrity incidents, including suspected cheating, impersonation, or unauthorized sharing of exam content. Work with Security, Legal, and delivery vendors to document evidence, route cases to the appropriate decision-makers, and communicate and implement approved outcomes, such as score invalidation or credential revocation.
* Administer appeals and independent reviews. Set intake and response timelines, assemble the case record, screen for conflicts of interest, and route decisions to qualified reviewers who were not involved in the original decision. Document and communicate outcomes without deciding cases you administer.
* Coordinate Legal guidance on candidate policiesance to improve delivery.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have owned operations or candidate policy for professional certification, licensure, high-stakes assessment, or a similarly governed program.
* Have taken a certification, licensure, or comparable high-stakes program from launch readiness through live delivery, and can show how you used operational data and candidate feedback to identify recurring problems and improve delivery.
* Have experience working at a technology company in a fast-paced environment, setting priorities and delivering work amid changing requirements and evolving business needs.
* Have defined candidate-facing policies and translated them into clear communications and operational workflows that internal teams and vendors can apply consistently.
* Have built or run an accommodations processation.
* Have administered incidents, complaints, appeals, or exceptions, documenting decisions and maintaining review by people who were not involved in the original decision.
* Have managed external delivery vendors against service standards and followed through when those standards were not met.
* Have handled sensitive candidate, assessment, or credential records and worked with privacy or security teams on appropriate controls.
* Have translated complex policies into candidate communications and operational guidance, and coordinated implementation across vendors and internal teams without direct reporting authority.
* Have personally written operational playbooks, checked launch readiness, triaged cases, and improved delivery processes.
* Have resolved time-sensitive operational issues within established policy and escalated exceptions to the appropriate decision-makers.
* Have applied accessibility, fairness, and credential-integrity policies consistently in candidate-facing operations.

Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.
  
  
Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

jobs.title: GTM Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Firmable is the market-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia-Pacific. Our competitive moat is our data: the deepest, most localised company and people dataset in every market we operate in. We've proven the model in ANZ. Now we're scaling it across Southeast Asia and the US.

**US reps can only sell as fast as the systems behind them. This role builds and runs the engine that turns their activity into clean, trusted pipeline.**

**The role**
------------

The **GTM Operations Analyst** owns the tooling, data and processes our US sales team relies on every day, so pipeline is built, tracked and measured properly from day one.

This is not a ticket-taking admin role. You'll own Nooks end to end, shape account allocation, build the reporting US leadership runs on, and work with GTM Engineering to automate away rep busywork.

Reporting to the Head of Growth (Melbourne), with a strong dotted line to the VP Americas. Based in San Francisco.

**About 75% hands-on execution:** tool admin, HubSpot, campaigns, reporting and rep support. **About 25% process improvement:** fixing friction and rolling out new tooling.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **US sales tooling:** own and administer Nooks (configuration, users, integrations, adoption), evaluate new tools and train reps so they stick
* **Campaigns:** build, launch and measure outbound and multi-channel US campaigns with GTM Engineering
* **Account allocation:** keep territory and ownership rules clear, balanced and enforced in our systems
* **HubSpot administration:** support global RevOps on properties, workflows, pipelines, reporting and users for the US team
* **Data integrity:** keep data accurate across systems so pipeline, attribution and performance tracking can be trusted
* **Reporting:** build the dashboards that give the VP Americas and Head of Growth a clear view of US pipeline, activity and conversion
* **Enablement:** Notion documentation, playbooks and process fixes that remove manual work for reps
* **Global alignment:** be the link between the US team and Australia, and support rep onboarding and lifecycle tracking

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

**Must haves**

* **RevOps experience:** around 2 years in RevOps, sales ops or GTM ops, ideally supporting an outbound team at a B2B SaaS company
* **Hands-on HubSpot:** you've built properties, workflows, lists, pipelines and reports, not just used them
* **Sales engagement tool ownership:** you've administered Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft, Lemlist or similar
* **Data quality instinct:** you notice when numbers don't add up and fix the process, not just the record
* **Clear communicator:** you translate between sales, marketing and technical teams, and write docs reps actually use
* **Self-directed across time zones:** you prioritise well when the US and global teams both need you
* **You live and breathe AI tools.** You use AI for analysis, automation, documentation and troubleshooting by default. In 2026, this is how one GTM Ops Analyst supports an entire US sales team, and you need to already be doing it.

**Highly valued**

* **HubSpot certifications**
* **Automation tooling:** n8n, Zapier or similar
* **Startup or scaleup background** where you've had to build the standard, not inherit it

**The environment**
-------------------

Firmable runs lean and ships fast: small senior teams, no layers, minimal process. You'll sit in San Francisco with the US sales team, working closely with Growth, GTM Engineering and RevOps in Melbourne.

We are an **AI-native organisation**: AI is our default operating mode, from pipeline and data-quality analysis to automated rep workflows and agentic campaign research. If you're not already working this way, this role isn't right for you.

**Why this role**
-----------------

* **Build the US engine from the ground up:** shape the systems the US sales team runs on
* **Real ownership:** own US tooling with a direct line to the Head of Growth and VP Americas
* **Real career runway:** grow into RevOps lead, GTM systems or US operations leadership; the ceiling is set by output, not tenure

**This role probably isn't for you if**
---------------------------------------

* You want a ticket queue and a clear spec for every request
* Fixing the record feels like enough, even when the process that broke it is still running
* Reps feel like end users to manage rather than customers to serve
* You do your best work inside an established RevOps function with documented systems
* A manager in another time zone and a lot of autonomy sounds more stressful than exciting
* AI is still on your "to learn" list rather than part of how you work every day

new_jobs.title: Customer Organization Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
*\*An internal or pre-identified candidate is currently under consideration, but all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.*

  

**Customer Organization Program Manager**

  

Join Epicor as a Program manager! The Customer Organization Program Manager owns the development of Epicor's FY27 sales plays from strategy to enablement. You will turn identified sales plays into playbooks, content and training that help sellers lead with business outcomes, not features.

  

You'll sit at the center of Sales, Product Marketing and Demand Generation. You'll build the programs and hand-offs that connect them, so every launch, campaign and training lands as one cohesive story for sellers and customers. This is a new role on a growing Revenue Enablement team, with the ability to influence how Epicor goes to market.

  

**What you will be doing**

  

**Own the sales plays**

  

* Build and maintain a playbook for each FY27 sales play: target personas (CFO, COO, CIO, CXO), verticals, discovery questions, value messages, proof points, objection handling and competitive positioning.

* Identify the content each play needs at each sales stage, audit what exists, and fill the gaps.

* Coordinate content development between Sales, Product Marketing and SMEs, managing timelines, owners and approvals.

* Coordinate rollout and training for each play alongside enablement lead, from launch sessions to manager coaching guides and reinforcement.

Run the rolling 2-quarter enablement roadmap with Product Marketing, so product launches are packaged into play-based training.  

  

**Strengthen the Marketing–Sales partnership**

  

* Design programs and clear hand-offs between Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales, from MQL to SAL through to Discovery.

* Act as stakeholder from Sales on Insight conference development and delivery.

* Align campaign messaging with sales plays so sellers can follow up on what marketing starts.

Set up feedback loops with sellers and sales leaders and bring field insight back to Marketing and Product.  

  

**Activate plays in market**

  

* Work with Marketing and regional sales leaders on market activation: campaigns, events, account-based programs and partner motions tied to each play.

* Work with enablement lead to select the right format for each audience and moment, such as live sessions, microlearning, play kits, battlecards, talk tracks, demo stories and digital sales rooms.

Write clear, compelling seller-facing communications for launches, play updates and program news.  

  

**Measure and improve**

  

* Define and report success measures for each play: adoption, content usage, pipeline created and win rate in the target segment.

Use the data to refine plays, retire content that isn't working, and prioritize what comes next.  

  

**Other enablement projects**

  

* Support broader Customer Organization strategic initiatives, including leader programs, sales kickoffs, onboarding and tools rollouts, and others as assigned.

Support with Chief of Staff duties as assigned.  

  

**What you will likely bring**

  

* 10+ years of experience across sales enablement, product or solution marketing, sales programs, or marketing communications in B2B technology. Experience in an ERP organization or similar complex SaaS is required.

* A track record of building sales plays, playbooks or go-to-market programs that sellers actually use.

* Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex product capabilities into clear business outcome and value messages.

* Program management discipline: you can run multiple workstreams, timelines and stakeholders at once and keep them on track.

* Experience influencing without authority across Sales, Marketing and Product, including with senior leaders.

* Comfort designing and delivering training, both live and virtual, to sales audiences.

* An analytical mindset, with experience using CRM and enablement data to measure impact.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.  

  

**What could set you apart**

  

* Background in communications or PR, especially message development, internal communications or change communications.

* Experience with ERP, supply chain or industry software sold to manufacturing, distribution, retail, automotive or building supply businesses.

* Familiarity with value selling, MEDDICC, Challenger or similar sales methodologies.

* Hands-on experience with tools such as Salesforce, Gong, Highspot, Seismic or an LMS.

* Experience with account-based marketing, demand generation programs or partner enablement.

* Experience using AI tools to speed up content creation, research or enablement delivery.

Prior experience leading or mentoring others, or a desire to build a team.  

  

**What success looks like in your first year**

  

* **First 60 days:** Learn the four plays, sellers and stakeholders. Audit existing content against each play, and build first sales play.

* **By 6 months:** Launch complete playbooks for at least three plays, with training delivered to Account Executives/TMs and CAMs, and an agreed Marketing-to-Sales hand-off process.

* **By 12 months:** All four plays are live and refreshed quarterly. Fewer standalone feature trainings reach sellers, and play adoption and pipeline impact are reported to leadership each quarter.

Program Manager
  
  
Lead all phases of complex information technology projects designed as solutions with university-wide impact, and that require high levels of functional integration and involving multiple disciplines to be managed. Perform the full range of the project management lifecycle**:** discovery initiating, planning, budgeting, executing, governance, monitoring and controlling, and closing. Leverage steering and executive committees for decision-making, change management, and communications. Advise unit/school regarding post project operations. Provide training to clients/staff.
  
  
IFPS Program Manager

Role **Summary**

  

University is looking for a Program Manager who can translate the agreed vision for a university-wide financial planning platform into a realistic, sequenced project plan and drive disciplined execution.
  
This person needs to operate at the center of a highly decentralized environment, coordinating across finance, IT, schools, and an implementation partner. Working under the direction of the IFPS Business Lead, the Program Manager will manage project operations, governance logistics, risks, commitments, and execution across workstreams, while coordinating stakeholder engagement and change activities.

Must-Have Experience
  
  
Proven success managing complex enterprise technology implementations through multiple project phases.

Exceptional project execution skills**:** integrated scheduling, dependencies, risk and issue management, action tracking, meeting operations, documentation, and reliable follow-through.
  
Excellent Zoom and SharePoint skills, including complex meeting scheduling and administration, screen sharing, document libraries, permissions, version control, and secure information sharing. Advanced proficiency with Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.
  
Experience with Smartsheet; ability to maintain a detailed working schedule and produce clear, digestible leadership-facing timelines.
  
Demonstrated discretion and sound judgment in handling confidential financial, personnel, procurement, contractual, and governance information. Appropriate access decisions and information sharing are essential.
  
Experience operating across complex stakeholder groups, ideally in higher education or a similarly decentralized or federated environment.
  
Excellent written and verbal communication, including accurate meeting notes, polished stakeholder materials, concise status reports, and clear decision documentation.
  
Strong judgment about when to act independently, when to coordinate with the Business Lead or workstream lead, and when to escalate.

Nice-to-Haves
  
Direct Anaplan or financial planning platform implementation experience.
  
Higher education and/or federated organizational experience.
  
Formal program or change management training.

What Makes This Role Distinct / Why It’s Interesting
  
One of the first recent University-wide solutions intended for all Schools/Units, rather than a small pilot.
  
The end state cannot be fully standardized**:** it must balance shared University-level data and processes with legitimate local variation, while remaining reliable and sustainable.
  
High visibility with senior leadership. The Program Manager will be central to maintaining a realistic plan, preparing decision-ready materials, and keeping leadership accurately informed.

What Kind of Person Thrives Here
  
  
Enterprise-minded but pragmatic; understands that perfect standardization is not possible.
  
Diplomatic with backbone**:** builds trust, listens well, frames trade-offs, and follows through.
  
Comfortable in a consensus-oriented culture where relationships and patience matter alongside subject matter expertise.
  
Exceptionally reliable, organized, detail-oriented, and self-sufficient; closes loops without repeated reminders.
  
Proactive but appropriately consultative; learns the context before changing processes and coordinates sensitive stakeholder outreach.
  
Calm under pressure, receptive to feedback, and able to adjust quickly as priorities shift.
  
Can bridge finance and IT; they don’t have to be a technologist, but must be credible with these teams.

Key Deliverables (Designed, Socialized, Accepted, and Implemented in Conjunction with Internal and External Partners)

A. Program Strategy, Scope, and Roadmap

Responsibilities
  
Translate program direction established by the Business Lead and governance into a detailed phase plan for design and implementation.
  
Coordinate scope definition and change control with the Business Lead, Solution Architect, and implementation partner; document agreed common and School/Unit-**specific requirements**.
  
Align the roadmap with major finance cycles and stakeholder capacity constraints.
  
Maintain an integrated schedule and refine sequencing as design sessions, data realities, and stakeholder feedback evolve.

Key Deliverables
  
Monthly project health and executive summaries.
  
Detailed, Smartsheet-ready multi-phase schedule with dates, owners, dependencies, and milestones, paired with a concise leadership-facing roadmap.
  
Documented scope decisions, changes, and prioritized backlog maintained with the appropriate business and technical owners.

B. Governance & Decision-Making

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** - bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

**About the Role:**

This role owns a multi-project program within one of the product workstreams — Banking and Treasury, Priority Commerce Engine, Merchant and Partner Solutions, or a Core Platform Shared Services domain such as billing or payment rails. You will coordinate several concurrent projects and their interdependencies across engineering, product, and operations, holding one plan and one version of status for the program.

This is an individual contributor role within the Enterprise PMO's Product Launch Delivery tower. It owns how the work ships, not what ships or how it is architected. The role reports to the tower's Delivery Lead and works to the methodology and reporting standards set by PMO Operations and CoE. Customer implementations sit in a separate tower, and product-facing software delivery sits in Product Launch Delivery.

**Responsibilities:**

* Owns delivery of a multi-project program within an assigned product workstream, including schedule, scope integrity, and dependency management across its constituent projects.
* Maintains the program plan, milestones, critical path, and RAID log, and keeps them current enough to be used for decisions rather than for reporting.
* Coordinates cross-functional delivery across engineering, product, quality, and operations to a shared date.
* Produces effort and duration estimates for planned work, and flags feasibility before a date is committed.
* Runs the delivery cadence for the program: planning, standing reviews, dependency checkpoints, and escalation.
* Manages release entry and exit criteria for the program's releases, partnering with Release Coordination on deployment readiness.
* Carries regulatory and control requirements as plan items where the program touches SOC 2 or PCI DSS scope.
* Reports program status through the EPMO Intelligence Portal to the standards set by PMO Operations and CoE.
* Mentors project managers and associate project managers working within the program.
* Contributes patterns and lessons learned to the launch playbook through the quarterly pattern loop.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* The program delivers to its committed dates, and slippage is forecast rather than discovered.
* Dependencies between the program's projects are visible and sequenced, not resolved by escalation.
* Engineering and product partners work from one plan and one version of status.
* Scope changes arrive through a defined route with effort and date impact attached, rather than as verbal commitments.
* Release readiness is evidenced, and post-release defects are the exception.
* Project managers in the program grow measurably against the next level's scope.

**Candidate Requirements:**

**Required**

* 6–8 years in project or program management, including ownership of a multi-project program with interdependencies.
* Experience delivering software or platform work across more than one engineering team.
* Working fluency with integration and release mechanics: environments, dependency sequencing, release criteria, and UAT.
* Demonstrated cross-functional coordination without direct authority.
* Disciplined execution mechanics: an honest critical path, actively used RAID logs, and status reporting leadership can act on.
* Experience in a regulated delivery environment such as SOC 2 or PCI DSS.
* Fluency with both agile and waterfall delivery approaches.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred**

* PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM certification.
* Payments or fintech domain exposure: acquiring, banking and treasury, payables, billing, or payment rails.
* Experience working with an offshore development team.
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Ai tooling.
* Exposure to Lean or Six Sigma methods applied to cycle-time reduction.

**Work Environment & Culture:**

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand - *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Location:** US (Remote); preference for candidates on Eastern Time

**Compensation:** $80,000 - $90,000 per year + Stock Options

##### **About Argyle**

Argyle is a fast-growing, remote-first, Series C startup solving a consumer data problem.

For decades, financial service providers and other businesses have collected and verified consumer income, employment, and asset data the same way: by hand or via verification databases. These methods are expensive, time consuming, high friction, and/or unreliable. In turn, experiences like applying for a loan or completing a background check are challenging for service providers and consumers alike.

The solution is Argyle. We’re the leading provider of direct-source, consumer-permissioned income, employment, and asset verifications. We make it fast and easy to gain secure and reliable access to the most complete real-time datasets stored in consumers’ payroll and banking accounts, so service providers can automate verification workflows, save time, reduce risks, lower costs, and build better product experiences.

Named one of America’s Best Startup Employers of 2026 by Forbes, Argyle largely serves the mortgage, government benefits, tenant screening, lending, and background check industries as well as the gig economy.

Founded in 2018, Argyle’s commitment to innovation is backed by investors including Bain Capital Ventures, Checkr, Mastercard, Rockefeller Asset Management and SignalFire.

##### **About the team**

Revenue Operations runs the critical business operations that keep Argyle’s sales motion moving fast, from deal approvals and contracting to billing, commissions, and the CRM. We’re a small team of experienced operators, and we lean heavily on automation and AI tools to do more with less.

This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who wants to learn from an experienced RevOps team and own real processes within a few months. You’ll work daily with account executives, customer success managers, marketing, and finance.

##### **What You’ll Do**

* **Be the first stop for RevOps requests.** Own the request queue for Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Handle the routine work yourself, from contract amendments and exports to pricing reviews, SKU setup, and Salesforce cleanup. On every request, engage stakeholders and pressure-test their asks until you land on a solution or a clear escalation path.
* **Own monthly billing preparation.** Run most of the pre-invoice process each month, from custom billing processes, credits tracking, and discrepancies review to finalizing amounts each customer owes.
* **Build controls that scale.** Run recurring checks that signed contracts, billing setup, and platform access line up, and turn repeat requests into documented processes or automation, including AI-assisted workflows.
* **Handle routine deal desk approvals.** Review opportunities in Salesforce for completeness, pricing setup, and contract dates before approval, and resolve setup issues that slow deals down.
* **Manage the customer account lifecycle.** Handle activations, terminations, reinstatements, and access changes, and keep Salesforce and our billing platform in sync.
* **Keep CRM data clean.** Maintain accounts, contacts, ownership, and pipeline hygiene. Monitor the health of the HubSpot–Salesforce sync to ensure a smooth handoff from Marketing to Sales.
* **Support partner and government reporting.** Help prepare monthly and quarterly revenue share reports for channel and integration partners, plus recurring reporting on our government contracts.
* **Co-own sales commissions.** Learn our monthly commission process hands-on, then share ownership of running it each month, from calculating payouts to keeping the process accurate and on time.

##### **What Success Looks Like**

* **Month 1:** You’ve worked through a full billing cycle and the request queue alongside the team, and you’ve shadowed the monthly commissions process.
* **Month 2:** You own most of billing preparation and routine requests on your own, and you’ve used AI tools to automate your first repetitive steps.
* **Month 3:** You own all billing preparation, serve as the front line for the RevOps request queue, and co-own the monthly commission process.
* **Ongoing:** You’re the first response to GTM requests and resolve most of them yourself. You run the monthly pre-invoice process and own key communications between GTM and Finance throughout. With the time AI automation frees up, you spend more of your month on higher-level business analysis.

##### **What We’re Looking For**

* 1–3 years in revenue operations or sales operations, ideally at a B2B SaaS business
* Comfort working in Salesforce day to day, from building reports and updating records in bulk to troubleshooting validation rules
* Experience building reports in Looker or another BI tool, and turning that data into analyses that solve real business problems
* Strong spreadsheet skills, including lookups, pivots, and reconciling data across sources
* A high bar for accuracy and attention to detail, since you’ll work with the contract, billing, and commissions data behind our revenue
* Interest in using AI tools to automate repetitive work
* Clear written communication with internal teams and customers
* **Nice to have:** Salesforce Administrator certification; familiarity with HubSpot; exposure to mortgage, lending, or fintech

##### **Why Argyle?**

* **Remote-first.** Join a globally distributed team.
* **Strong teammates.** Work alongside smart, thoughtful, and ambitious people who genuinely care about delivering best-in-class service.
* **High standards, low ego.** We hold ourselves to a high bar and keep egos out of it.
* **Real ownership.** Everyone owns meaningful work and has the flexibility to work in a way that suits them.
* **Inclusive by design.** We’re intentional about building a team where different backgrounds and perspectives lead to better ideas and stronger collaboration.

Description:

OHG Brands is home to America’s original, iconic restaurant brands. The company strategically develops and grows a diverse portfolio of fast-casual, quick-service and casual dining concepts around the world, using brand heritage as the foundation for growth and innovation that resonates with the next generation of fans. OHG Brands currently operates 12 restaurant brands: Round Table Pizza, Fatburger, Marble Slab Creamery, Johnny Rockets, Fazoli’s, Great American Cookies, Buffalo’s Cafe & Express, Hurricane Grill & Wings, Native Grill & Wings, Pretzelmaker, and Ponderosa and Bonanza Steakhouses, and franchises and owns over 1,700 units worldwide.

We are looking for an Operations Analyst, Performance Analytics. As the Operations Analyst, you will be the analytical partner to Operations and the field, connecting audit, guest, sales and traffic data to show what drives store results and which stores need help.

What you’ll do:  

* Build the operations views of the Store Scorecard and the weekly reporting field teams use to decide where to go.
* Report on third-party food safety and brand standards audits (such as Steritech): scores, trends, repeat failures and open corrective actions.
* Analyze guest surveys and online and delivery-app reviews for the themes driving store performance.
* Build the field visit tracker: visits against plan, visit scores and open actions.
* Follow up with field consultants and franchisees on stores that are missing, late or have gone dark, so the store list stays complete.
* Over time, build the franchisee health view and track new stores against each brand’s ramp curve.
* Document your work, and use AI tools every day, checking the output before it is used.

In your first 90 days: Operations reporting is in weekly use and every store that has gone dark has a confirmed status.

Requirements:

* 2+ years in analytics, reporting or insights, ideally supporting operations, field teams, quality or customer experience.
* Experience analyzing survey, review, audit or operational performance data, with sound judgment about small samples; you can turn a pile of comments or audit findings into a few themes leaders can act on, backed by numbers.
* Strong Excel and Power BI, strong PowerPoint, and working proficiency with Word, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint; working SQL on a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.
* Regular, hands-on use of AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot) for real work, with good judgment about checking the output and handling guest and franchisee data.
* You connect store-level data from different sources and know when a comparison isn’t fair (store age, size, sample, a partial week).
* A clear communicator with Operations, field and senior leaders, with discretion on sensitive audit and franchisee information, and persistent, courteous follow-up until an issue is closed.
* Drive: you turn data into action, follow through, and are comfortable building without a playbook.
* A track record of documenting your work so others can pick it up.

  

Preferred:  

* Experience analyzing audit, inspection or quality assurance data (food safety audits preferred).
* Restaurant, franchise or multi-unit experience, or time in restaurant operations (for example as a general manager or area manager).
* Experience with a guest feedback platform, public review sites, or franchisee P&L and royalty reporting.

**Job Description:**

CSI is seeking a **Senior Data Analyst, Payments Reporting** to join our Qolo Data Operations team. This is a highly technical, hands-on role focused on building and supporting financial and transactional reporting for our payments platform.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Database Administration, and Finance Operations to develop accurate reporting, investigate transaction and balance discrepancies, and optimize SQL queries supporting high-volume payment and ledger data. You’ll also play an important role in enterprise client launches by translating reporting requirements into reliable, production-ready solutions

This role is ideal for someone who combines advanced SQL expertise with strong financial-data knowledge and enjoys digging into complex reporting and reconciliation issues to determine what’s happening behind the numbers.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build, maintain, and enhance financial and transactional reports supporting Qolo clients and internal teams.
* Develop and optimize complex SQL Server and T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and reporting processes.
* Translate reporting requirements into functional reports for new enterprise client implementations.
* Investigate reporting discrepancies, including missing transactions, balance mismatches, duplicate postings, timing differences, and pending versus posted transactions.
* Support financial reconciliation by comparing authorizations, settlements, and ledger postings and identifying variances.
* Troubleshoot slow-running or timing-out reports and partner with DBAs and Engineering to improve query performance.
* Analyze execution plans and address indexing, locking, blocking, and other database-performance issues.
* Document reporting logic, data sources, and business rules.
* Work closely with Product to understand reporting needs and support larger technical initiatives.
* Partner with developers and technical teams when reporting functionality requires broader application or system changes.
* Clearly communicate findings and financial-data discrepancies to both technical and nontechnical partners.

* Strong SQL performance-tuning skills, including experience with execution plans, indexing, statistics, and troubleshooting slow-running queries.
* Strong understanding of database fundamentals, data modeling, data integrity, and large transactional datasets.
* Experience building, scheduling, and supporting production reporting processes.
* Experience working with financial or transactional data where accuracy across amounts, balances, dates, and reporting periods is critical.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or another financial-services environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify the root cause of complex data discrepancies.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to nontechnical business partners.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, database, and operational teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of card and payment processing, including authorization, clearing, settlement, interchange, and chargebacks.

* Familiarity with Azure and cloud-based data environments.

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. **Job Summary**

Across the healthcare industry nationwide, hospitals and health systems face challenges to today’s approaches to expense management, as revenue growth has not kept pace with expense growth. In response to these unprecedented external challenges, MGB launched Sustain in fall of 2023. Sustain is an ongoing organization-wide program that works to build an infrastructure, culture, and mindset around continuous improvement, working to preserve our four-part mission through focus on resource stewardship. To do this, while also funding needed capital maintenance and improvements to deliver on world-class patient care, research, education, and community health, we must seek out innovative opportunities to optimize the way we work and manage resources across our organization.  
  
The Sustain Analytics team is part of the Business Planning department, which also includes Decision Support and Business Analytics teams. new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Information Security
new_jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

  

Compass is building the first modern end-to-end real estate platform, integrating agents, buyers, and sellers through technology.

The security organization protects that platform and the people who use it. We run identity, detection and response, vulnerability management, and compliance across a growing portfolio of businesses and brands, and we are bringing them onto one security operating model.

As Staff Technical Program Manager for Information Security, you own the programs that bring identity, attack surface, detection and response, vulnerability management, and compliance onto one measurable operating model across Compass. You will work across organizations that do not report to you, on problems that arrive without a plan attached, setting the sequence, naming the tradeoff, and bringing leadership a recommendation rather than a status update. This is a senior individual contributor role.

**At Compass You Will:**
------------------------

* Own the portfolio of highest-ambiguity security programs across Compass, spanning multiple organizations on a 12 to 18 month horizon, and set the plan where one does not yet exist.
* Lead security integration programs across existing and newly acquired Compass businesses, bringing security tooling, policy, and data onto a common standard.
* Lead identity programs covering human and non-human identities, including service accounts and AI agents, toward one source of truth with broad MFA coverage and centralized authentication through Okta.
* Partner with vulnerability management and detection and response to land one company-wide remediation SLA and centralized log and detection coverage, with closure confirmed in production.
* Drive reduction programs across accounts, permissions, integrations, endpoints, and duplicate tooling, and report the net change in exposed components each quarter.
* Maintain one control set mapped to SOX IT general controls and NIST CSF 2.0, and advance automated evidence generation from the systems that run security.
* Build and maintain a single searchable record of security metrics, documentation, and risk decisions, and turn it into the executive narratives that drive decisions, including reporting into executive and board-level committees.
* Own cross-organizational tradeoffs in scope, schedule, and technical approach, and bring executives a recommendation and a date rather than an open question.
* Set the standard for how security programs are run, including intake, prioritization, quarterly and annual planning, and reporting, and coach the engineers, analysts, and team leads who own initiatives of their own.

**What We Look For:**
---------------------

* BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 10+ years of technical program management experience, or equivalent demonstrated scope, including time owning programs at staff or principal level.
* A track record of owning programs across multiple organizations where no plan existed at the start, and landing them.
* Demonstrated influence at the Director and VP level, including changing a leadership decision with data and a written recommendation.
* Experience consolidating security programs, tooling, or policy following a merger or acquisition.
* Depth in identity and access, including Okta, service accounts and other non-human identities, just-in-time access, and entitlement reviews.

At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

### **The Role**

The best software companies don't grow through direct sales alone. They grow through ecosystems: networks of partners who extend their reach, deepen customer relationships and deliver outcomes no single company can deliver alone. Technology partners sit closest to the product. They are the platforms, data tools and AI services our customers already use, and how well Braze works with them shapes what customers can build.

Technology partnerships at Braze take three forms. Product partnerships are built into the product, where Braze and a partner's technology work together for customers. Strategic partnerships are held at a senior level with a small number of platform companies, including the major cloud and large language model providers. And a long tail of ISVs integrate with Braze and extend what customers can do. Each form has grown on its own terms, and the strategy that connects them is still being written.

This role is key to that strategy. Reporting to the AVP, Partner Experience, you own the strategy, program and plan for technology partnerships in all three forms, and you define it in close collaboration with the VP, Technology Partnerships, who leads the strategic relationships. That means deciding what a technology partner is at Braze, what each type gets from us and what we expect back, and how product, strategic and ISV partnerships fit together, so that partners, Product and the field see one ecosystem rather than three separate efforts. This role owns the strategic and program layer that turns that strategy into something partners and internal teams can actually run on.

Design a referral program that works in both directions between Braze and technology partners.

**Job Summary**  
Join the Defense Enclave Services (DES) program and help keep enterprise IT running for the Department of Defense Fourth Estate. DES supports the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) in delivering and sustaining enterprise IT services across DODNet.  
As the **Queue Manager / ITSM Operations Analyst**, you will oversee the incident and service request queues that support DODNet operations every day. You will make sure tickets are correctly prioritized, assigned, tracked, and resolved within service level agreements (SLAs) and contract performance standards. You will be the central coordination point for queue performance across supported teams. You will use ticket data to reduce backlogs, prevent avoidable SLA breaches, and give leadership clear, actionable reporting.  
**Location:** Fort Meade, MD  
**Clearance: Active Secret,** must be US Citizen  
  
**What’s in it for you:**

* Join a premier technology firm specializing in innovative solutions.
* Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and innovative work culture.
* Enjoy tremendous growth potential in a high-performing team environment.
* A robust benefits package:
  + Health, dental, and vision insurance
  + Life insurance
  + Short-and-long term disability
  + Paid time off (PTO)
  + 401k retirement plan with employer match
  + Annual Professional Development Reimbursement Program
  + And more!

Incident and Service Request Queue Management

* Find unassigned, misrouted, stalled, or aging tickets, and work with the right technical teams to correct them.

* Work with technical leads and functional managers to balance workloads and address resource constraints.

* Track ticket performance against contract SLAs, Acceptable Quality Levels (AQLs), and internal targets.

* Monitor ticket quality, including assignment accuracy, status updates, documentation, and closure practices.

* Set and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) that measure how well the queues are managed.
* Support program management reviews, customer briefings, performance improvement plans, and contract reporting.

**Please note:** This is a full-time **shift-based role**, requiring you to work a rotating pattern of early, late and night shifts, including weekends. Your shift pattern will be fixed. While flexibility around shifts may be limited, we'll work with you wherever possible to support a healthy work-life balance and take account of responsibilities outside of work. Further information about the shift pattern will be shared with successful candidates.

**Flexible working:** Due to the nature of this role, flexible, home or remote working isn’t possible.

**About us**

MI5keeps the country safe from serious threats like terrorism and attempts by states to harm the UK, its people and way of life. We carry out investigations by obtaining, analysing and assessing intelligence, and then work with a range of partners, including MI6 and GCHQ to disrupt these threats. Through our protective security arm, we provide advice and guidance to government, businesses and other organisations about how to keep themselves safe. A role in MI5 means you’ll do unique and challenging work in a supportive and encouraging environment, making a real difference to UK national security.

**The role**  
Those who seek to harm the UK don’t work 9am to 5pm, so neither do we. Intelligence Operations Analysts gather information and provide a rapid response to operational teams working around the clock. We analyse data to identify serious and often hidden threats. You’ll work closely with colleagues across MI5 to understand their requirements and learn how to use our tools and techniques to assess a range of intelligence, including audio files, images and written communications, large data sets and location data.

The intelligence gathered doesn’t always reveal the full story. You’ll help unlock the details to determine what’s happening right now, whether it’s cause for concern, and what could happen next. You’ll analyse information as it becomes available from a range of sources, identify patterns and anomalies, and share your findings clearly and accurately to support operational decision-making.

Whether you’re on an early, late or night shift, you’ll be supporting live activity rather than building a picture over weeks or months, helping teams make decisions in the moment. And you won’t be doing it alone. The nature of the shifts and the importance of the work means we share a common goal and a real sense of camaraderie and team support. This is a role with real impact; the insight and connections you and your team provide could lead to major turning points in live investigations.

You’ll receive regular days off throughout your shift cycle, including extended periods away from work, plus dedicated personal development time. **Please note, you’ll need to be able to commute to West London and be ready to start work promptly for early shifts**.

**About you**

You might be a final year undergraduate or a recent graduate, returning to work after a break, looking for a career change or simply a new challenge. To apply, you'll have, or be expected to obtain by September 2027, a 2:2 degree or above in any subject **or** at least one year's full-time work experience using the core skills needed for analysis. Specific analyst experience isn’t required, but you should be able to demonstrate an ability to analyse information, data, evidence or trends. This may have come from your studies, work or everyday life.

Importantly, you’ll have an interest in innovation and enjoy solving problems and puzzles, or finding out what makes things work. So, you’ll be curious; someone who forms conclusions based on evidence. Resilience is key; you’ll be comfortable working at pace and under pressure as you’ll be supporting live activity as it unfolds. You might not always get the right answer from what you’re analysing, so you’ll stay focused, patient and adapt to changing demands and intricate problems as required.

Collaboration is critical. You might be understanding unique requirements, communicating complex analytics to non-technical colleagues, writing handover notes at the end of your shift, or presenting your findings. You’ll be clear and to-the-point, especially when working on something time-sensitive. At all times, you’ll combine attention to detail with sound judgement in time-critical scenarios.

Please note that there is a hearing test as part of the application process. This is because the role will involve listening to audio files. If you wear hearing aids, you’ll be able to complete the test using them.

To perform roles effectively across MI5, employees need to be able to understand information provided in English, including emails, workplace communications and other work-related documents; communicate in English as part of meetings and discussions; and produce and respond to written communications in English relevant to their role.

Shift and weekend allowances begin once training has been successfully completed.

new_jobs.title: Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
PGI is a global consultancy that helps organisations build digital resilience. We deploy our people to implement solutions on behalf of clients or to support them in developing their own capabilities. Our vision is a world resilient to digital threats and online harm. To achieve this, we need to grow our team of talented and passionate people. Our clients include some of the most well-known global brands, national governments, and innovative growing businesses. We operate in an exciting, fast-growing sector that bears increasing relevance and importance to nation-states, corporates, universities, and NGOs.

#### **What you'll be doing**

PGI’s threat intelligence functions continue to expand, driving our successful growth. As a Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Analyst, you will track threat actors, campaigns and criminal ecosystems, and turn findings into actionable intelligence for clients. The responsibilities of the post are as follows:

* Lead CTI engagements, owning analytic direction and output quality, and acting as senior analytical point of contact for clients.
* Produce strategic and tactical CTI products, from executive-level assessments that draw together cyber, physical and geopolitical indicators to actor profiles, threat landscapes and alerts, tailored to each client’s requirements.
* Monitor and research threat actors, including ransomware and extortion groups, initial access brokers, hacktivists and state-linked actors.
* Collect, enrich and pivot on technical indicators to attribute activity and uncover wider campaigns.
* Identify client exposure, including leaked credentials, breaches, brand impersonation, lookalike domains and attack surface weaknesses, escalating urgent issues promptly.
* Work with clients to define and refine priority intelligence requirements (PIRs), and present findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Apply rigorous analytic standards: source evaluation, confidence language and clear separation of fact, assessment and judgement, and act as a peer reviewer for other analysts’ work through our QA process.
* Build and improve our collection, enrichment and threat actor tracking tools and workflows, including responsible use of AI for tasks.
* Design and deliver table-top exercises and training that take clients through realistic threat scenarios.
* Mentor junior analysts, sharing tradecraft and raising analytic standards.
* Contribute to proposals and thought leadership.

#### **One day one you will bring**

* At least five years’ experience in cyber threat intelligence or threat research, ideally in a consultancy, government, intelligence or security vendor environment, including leading projects and mentoring or reviewing other analysts’ work.
* Deep understanding of the threat landscape, including attack techniques, the cybercrime economy, state-linked activity and emerging AI-enabled threats such as deepfake and identity fraud.
* Excellent written English, with experience producing concise, well-evidenced assessments for both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to build or automate collection and enrichment tooling (e.g. Python), and familiarity with CTI platforms and indicator analysis.
* Experience researching safely in dark web and closed-source environments, with sound OPSEC and discretion with sensitive information.
* Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and structured analytic techniques, and the ability to express confidence and uncertainty clearly.
* Desirable: experience designing and delivering training or table-top exercises; disinformation or influence operations analysis; malware or blockchain analysis; relevant certifications (e.g. GCTI, CREST CPTIA, OSIP); additional languages relevant to the threat landscape.
* Eligible for SC clearance and willing to undergo vetting.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at PGI**

As a British company which operates internationally, we draw strength from the diversity of our people. Without our diverse team, we couldn’t do the work we do. We are involved in projects across 80+ geographies, our people speak 25+ languages and come from a variety of backgrounds. By hiring and cultivating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, we can uphold values that enable every member of the team to thrive, while delivering novel solutions to novel problems.

**Accessibility at PGI**

Every individual has different requirements, so we are committed to implementing reasonable adjustments to mitigate physical and non-physical barriers in the workplace.

We strive to make the recruitment process as accessible as possible, but if you have any questions or concerns, please get in touch.

***Please note:*** *We are not accepting applications or speculative profiles from any recruitment agencies. If we require additional resource, we will reach out to you.*

new_jobs.title: Senior Deployment Strategist
new_jobs.description:
**About Euphoric**
------------------

Euphoric builds AI-first employee benefits administration software for the world's largest and most prestigious employers. We spun out of Peppy Health to take on what we believe is the biggest untouched opportunity in enterprise software.

Global employers spend $3–5 trillion on benefits every year. It is their second-largest cost after payroll, yet the category still runs on legacy systems and spreadsheets. Incumbents cannot move fast enough, and AI-first startups have mostly overlooked it.

We have two products:

* **GAP (Global Administration Platform)** for global benefits teams. It uses LLMs to parse and extract policy documents into a structured ontology, and gives admins spend and utilisation tools across every country they operate in.
* **Navigator**, the employee-facing product that helps people understand and use their benefits.

We are post product-market fit at seed stage, live with some of the world's largest household-name enterprises, and we land and expand country by country. Our big current focus is flexible benefits and open enrollment. We stay deliberately lean so that the people who join own a meaningful piece of what we build.

This is also genuine tech for good: better benefits administration directly improves the wellbeing and financial security of millions of employees.

**The Role**

As a **Senior** **Deployment Strategist** you will spend roughly 80% of your time on client work and 20% on developing our products. You will own a portfolio of approximately 1 to 3 enterprise accounts, depending on size, from post-sale through live launch and beyond.

This is not a project management role. With the Euphoric MCP you will build custom agents, automations and workflows for some of the world's largest employers. You will be on the edge of AI in the workplace, guiding how global enterprises roll AI out to their benefits teams and employees.

**What You’ll Do:**
-------------------

No two weeks are the same as a **Senior** **Deployment Strategist**, but you can expect to:

* **Own your accounts end to end.** Be the named owner for approximately 1 to 3 enterprise clients, depending on size, from post-sale handover through implementation, live launch, renewal and expansion into new countries.
* **Drive land and expand.** Configure demos and the actual product for potential expansions, from new countries to new employee populations, so clients see working product, not slides.
* **Deliver deployments.** Configure GAP and Navigator for each client, build implementation plans, run UAT, manage data and policy-document onboarding, handle support and track adoption on live data.
* **Go on site.** Spend real time with clients' benefits and HR teams, including regional rollouts and country launches. On average expect around 1 day a week on client site; it varies, with heavier weeks around launches and occasional international travel as our clients expand globally.
* **Lead workshops and train clients.** Run discovery and design workshops, and train client teams so they get full value from GAP and Navigator.
* **Build with the Euphoric MCP.** Design and ship custom agents, automations and workflows that solve each client's specific problems, from reporting and renewals to employee communications.
* **Run the relationship.** Be the day-to-day contact, write clear client emails, and build the decks, QBRs and proposals that move senior stakeholders, from benefits administrators up to global heads of reward.
* **Shape the product (~20%).** Work closely with core product, engineering and design to build out specific features and flows your accounts need. Bring field insight back so it becomes part of the core platform.
* **Step into product when it's quieter.** In weeks where client work is less intense, you are fully expected to support in a product capacity: specs, evals, prompts, testing and analytics.
* **Work hand in hand with Deployed Product Managers.** They will join you on site to learn how to improve the core product. You will own the client-specific work.

**Skills & Experience**
-----------------------

* **4+ years of enterprise deployment experience.** You have delivered enterprise-level client implementations in a B2B SaaS environment and handled difficult stakeholders along the way. This is essential.
* **Extremely AI-pilled.** You have a genuine, intense interest in AI and you build with it constantly: Claude Code, Cowork, Cursor, Codex, MCP integrations and agents. You will be asked to show your latest AI projects. This matters more than anything else.
* **A builder.** You want to build, not just advise. You are comfortable with APIs, data models and prompts, and you build agents and automations on clients' behalf yourself rather than writing a ticket for someone else.
* **Academically excellent.** You have an exceptional academic track record from a top university, with strong A-levels or equivalent. A STEM degree is desirable but not essential.
* **A strong communicator.** Your emails are crisp, your decks land after a few iterations, and you can explain technical ideas to non-technical audiences, up to senior executives.
* **High ownership.** You treat your accounts as your own business, follow through without being chased, and do what it takes on launch weeks.
* **A proven high performer.** You can point to reaching the top of something demanding: unusually fast promotion, elite sport or music, or national or international academic awards.

**What We Look For:**
---------------------

**You must already hold the required qualification, we cannot accept applications if you are still studying or awaiting the outcome of your degree.** If any of the qualifications detail is not provided or not clear, your application will be deemed ineligible.

For individuals based in Wales, the ability to speak Welsh is desirable.
